import Foundation.Logic.LogicSymbol

/-!
# Basic definitions and properties of semantics-related notions

This file defines the semantics of formulas based on Tarski's truth definitions.
Also provides 𝓜 characterization of compactness.

## Main Definitions
* `LO.Semantics`: The realization of 𝓜 formula.
* `LO.Compact`: The semantic compactness of Foundation.

## Notation
* `𝓜 ⊧ φ`: a proposition that states `𝓜` satisfies `φ`.
* `𝓜 ⊧* T`: a proposition that states that `𝓜` satisfies each formulae in a set `T`.

-/

namespace LO

class Semantics (F : outParam Type*) (M : Type*) where
  Realize : M → F → Prop

variable {M : Type*} {F : Type*} [𝓢 : Semantics F M]

namespace Semantics

infix:45 " ⊧ " => Realize

section

variable [LogicalConnective F] (M)

protected class Top where
  realize_top (𝓜 : M) : 𝓜 ⊧ (⊤ : F)

protected class Bot where
  realize_bot (𝓜 : M) : ¬𝓜 ⊧ (⊥ : F)

protected class And where
  realize_and {𝓜 : M} {φ ψ : F} : 𝓜 ⊧ φ ⋏ ψ ↔ 𝓜 ⊧ φ ∧ 𝓜 ⊧ ψ

protected class Or where
  realize_or {𝓜 : M} {φ ψ : F} : 𝓜 ⊧ φ ⋎ ψ ↔ 𝓜 ⊧ φ ∨ 𝓜 ⊧ ψ

protected class Imp where
  realize_imp {𝓜 : M} {φ ψ : F} : 𝓜 ⊧ φ ➝ ψ ↔ (𝓜 ⊧ φ → 𝓜 ⊧ ψ)

protected class Not where
  realize_not {𝓜 : M} {φ : F} : 𝓜 ⊧ ∼φ ↔ ¬𝓜 ⊧ φ

class Tarski extends
  Semantics.Top M,
  Semantics.Bot M,
  Semantics.And M,
  Semantics.Or M,
  Semantics.Imp M,
  Semantics.Not M
  where


attribute [simp]
  Top.realize_top
  Bot.realize_bot
  Not.realize_not
  And.realize_and
  Or.realize_or
  Imp.realize_imp

    𝓜 ⊧ φ ⭤ ψ ↔ ((𝓜 ⊧ φ) ↔ (𝓜 ⊧ ψ)) := by

content_full:
import Foundation.Logic.LogicSymbol

/-!
# Basic definitions and properties of semantics-related notions

This file defines the semantics of formulas based on Tarski's truth definitions.
Also provides 𝓜 characterization of compactness.

## Main Definitions
* `LO.Semantics`: The realization of 𝓜 formula.
* `LO.Compact`: The semantic compactness of Foundation.

## Notation
* `𝓜 ⊧ φ`: a proposition that states `𝓜` satisfies `φ`.
* `𝓜 ⊧* T`: a proposition that states that `𝓜` satisfies each formulae in a set `T`.

-/

namespace LO

class Semantics (F : outParam Type*) (M : Type*) where
  Realize : M → F → Prop

variable {M : Type*} {F : Type*} [𝓢 : Semantics F M]

namespace Semantics

infix:45 " ⊧ " => Realize

section

variable [LogicalConnective F] (M)

protected class Top where
  realize_top (𝓜 : M) : 𝓜 ⊧ (⊤ : F)

protected class Bot where
  realize_bot (𝓜 : M) : ¬𝓜 ⊧ (⊥ : F)

protected class And where
  realize_and {𝓜 : M} {φ ψ : F} : 𝓜 ⊧ φ ⋏ ψ ↔ 𝓜 ⊧ φ ∧ 𝓜 ⊧ ψ

protected class Or where
  realize_or {𝓜 : M} {φ ψ : F} : 𝓜 ⊧ φ ⋎ ψ ↔ 𝓜 ⊧ φ ∨ 𝓜 ⊧ ψ

protected class Imp where
  realize_imp {𝓜 : M} {φ ψ : F} : 𝓜 ⊧ φ ➝ ψ ↔ (𝓜 ⊧ φ → 𝓜 ⊧ ψ)

protected class Not where
  realize_not {𝓜 : M} {φ : F} : 𝓜 ⊧ ∼φ ↔ ¬𝓜 ⊧ φ

class Tarski extends
  Semantics.Top M,
  Semantics.Bot M,
  Semantics.And M,
  Semantics.Or M,
  Semantics.Imp M,
  Semantics.Not M
  where


attribute [simp]
  Top.realize_top
  Bot.realize_bot
  Not.realize_not
  And.realize_and
  Or.realize_or
  Imp.realize_imp

variable {M}

variable [Tarski M]

variable {𝓜 : M}

@[simp] lemma realize_iff {φ ψ : F} :
    𝓜 ⊧ φ ⭤ ψ ↔ ((𝓜 ⊧ φ) ↔ (𝓜 ⊧ ψ)) := by
  simp [LogicalConnective.iff, iff_iff_implies_and_implies]

@[simp] lemma realize_list_conj {l : List F} :
    𝓜 ⊧ l.conj ↔ ∀ φ ∈ l, 𝓜 ⊧ φ := by induction l <;> simp [*]

@[simp] lemma realize_finset_conj {s : Finset F} :
    𝓜 ⊧ s.conj ↔ ∀ φ ∈ s, 𝓜 ⊧ φ := by simp [Finset.conj]

@[simp] lemma realize_list_disj {l : List F} :
    𝓜 ⊧ l.disj ↔ ∃ φ ∈ l, 𝓜 ⊧ φ := by induction l <;> simp [*]

@[simp] lemma realize_finset_disj {s : Finset F} :
    𝓜 ⊧ s.disj ↔ ∃ φ ∈ s, 𝓜 ⊧ φ := by simp [Finset.disj]

end

class RealizeSet (𝓜 : M) (T : Set F) : Prop where
  RealizeSet : ∀ ⦃f⦄, f ∈ T → Realize 𝓜 f

infix:45 " ⊧* " => RealizeSet

variable (M)

def Valid (f : F) : Prop := ∀ 𝓜 : M, 𝓜 ⊧ f

def Satisfiable (T : Set F) : Prop := ∃ 𝓜 : M, 𝓜 ⊧* T

def models (T : Set F) : Set M := {𝓜 | 𝓜 ⊧* T}

variable {M}

def theory (𝓜 : M) : Set F := {φ | 𝓜 ⊧ φ}

class Meaningful (𝓜 : M) : Prop where
  exists_unrealize : ∃ f, ¬𝓜 ⊧ f

instance [LogicalConnective F] [Semantics.Bot M] (𝓜 : M) : Meaningful 𝓜 := ⟨⟨⊥, by simp⟩⟩

lemma meaningful_iff {𝓜 : M} : Meaningful 𝓜 ↔ ∃ f, ¬𝓜 ⊧ f :=
  ⟨by rintro ⟨h⟩; exact h, fun h ↦ ⟨h⟩⟩

lemma not_meaningful_iff (𝓜 : M) : ¬Meaningful 𝓜 ↔ ∀ f, 𝓜 ⊧ f := by simp [meaningful_iff]

lemma realizeSet_iff {𝓜 : M} {T : Set F} : 𝓜 ⊧* T ↔ ∀ ⦃f⦄, f ∈ T → Realize 𝓜 f :=
  ⟨by rintro ⟨h⟩ f hf; exact h hf, by intro h; exact ⟨h⟩⟩

lemma not_satisfiable_finset [LogicalConnective F] [Tarski M] [DecidableEq F] (t : Finset F) :
    ¬Satisfiable M (t : Set F) ↔ Valid M (t.image (∼·)).disj := by
  simp [Satisfiable, realizeSet_iff, Valid, Finset.map_disj]

lemma satisfiableSet_iff_models_nonempty {T : Set F} :
    Satisfiable M T ↔ (models M T).Nonempty :=
  ⟨by rintro ⟨𝓜, h𝓜⟩; exact ⟨𝓜, h𝓜⟩, by rintro ⟨𝓜, h𝓜⟩; exact ⟨𝓜, h𝓜⟩⟩

namespace RealizeSet

lemma realize {T : Set F} (𝓜 : M) [𝓜 ⊧* T] (hf : f ∈ T) : 𝓜 ⊧ f :=
  RealizeSet hf

lemma of_subset {T U : Set F} {𝓜 : M} (h : 𝓜 ⊧* U) (ss : T ⊆ U) : 𝓜 ⊧* T :=
  ⟨fun _ hf => h.RealizeSet (ss hf)⟩

lemma of_subset' {T U : Set F} {𝓜 : M} [𝓜 ⊧* U] (ss : T ⊆ U) : 𝓜 ⊧* T :=
  of_subset (𝓜 := 𝓜) inferInstance ss

instance empty' (𝓜 : M) : 𝓜 ⊧* (∅ : Set F) := ⟨by simp⟩

@[simp] lemma empty (𝓜 : M) : 𝓜 ⊧* (∅ : Set F) := ⟨by simp⟩

@[simp] lemma singleton_iff {f : F} {𝓜 : M} :
    𝓜 ⊧* {f} ↔ 𝓜 ⊧ f := by simp [realizeSet_iff]

@[simp] lemma insert_iff {T : Set F} {f : F} {𝓜 : M} :
    𝓜 ⊧* insert f T ↔ 𝓜 ⊧ f ∧ 𝓜 ⊧* T := by
  simp [realizeSet_iff]

@[simp] lemma union_iff {T U : Set F} {𝓜 : M} :
    𝓜 ⊧* T ∪ U ↔ 𝓜 ⊧* T ∧ 𝓜 ⊧* U := by
  simp [realizeSet_iff]
  exact
    ⟨ fun h => ⟨fun _ hf => h (Or.inl hf), fun _ hf => h (Or.inr hf)⟩,
      by rintro ⟨h₁, h₂⟩ f (h | h); exact h₁ h; exact h₂ h ⟩

@[simp] lemma image_iff {ι} {f : ι → F} {A : Set ι} {𝓜 : M} :
    𝓜 ⊧* f '' A ↔ ∀ i ∈ A, 𝓜 ⊧ (f i) := by simp [realizeSet_iff]

@[simp] lemma range_iff {ι} {f : ι → F} {𝓜 : M} :
    𝓜 ⊧* Set.range f ↔ ∀ i, 𝓜 ⊧ (f i) := by simp [realizeSet_iff]

                                            /-
                                              M : Type u_1

/-- Range of a function.

This function is more flexible than `f '' univ`, as the image requires that the domain is in Type
and not an arbitrary Sort. -/
def range (f : ι → α) : Set α := {x | ∃ y, f y = x}

/-!
# Basic definitions and properties of semantics-related notions

This file defines the semantics of formulas based on Tarski's truth definitions.
Also provides 𝓜 characterization of compactness.

## Main Definitions
* `LO.Semantics`: The realization of 𝓜 formula.
* `LO.Compact`: The semantic compactness of Foundation.

## Notation
* `𝓜 ⊧ φ`: a proposition that states `𝓜` satisfies `φ`.
* `𝓜 ⊧* T`: a proposition that states that `𝓜` satisfies each formulae in a set `T`.

-/

namespace LO

class Semantics (F : outParam Type*) (M : Type*) where
  Realize : M → F → Prop

variable {M : Type*} {F : Type*} [𝓢 : Semantics F M]

namespace Semantics

  realize_top (𝓜 : M) : 𝓜 ⊧ (⊤ : F)

protected class Bot where
  realize_bot (𝓜 : M) : ¬𝓜 ⊧ (⊥ : F)

protected class And where
  realize_and {𝓜 : M} {φ ψ : F} : 𝓜 ⊧ φ ⋏ ψ ↔ 𝓜 ⊧ φ ∧ 𝓜 ⊧ ψ

protected class Or where
  realize_or {𝓜 : M} {φ ψ : F} : 𝓜 ⊧ φ ⋎ ψ ↔ 𝓜 ⊧ φ ∨ 𝓜 ⊧ ψ

protected class Imp where
  realize_imp {𝓜 : M} {φ ψ : F} : 𝓜 ⊧ φ ➝ ψ ↔ (𝓜 ⊧ φ → 𝓜 ⊧ ψ)

protected class Not where
  realize_not {𝓜 : M} {φ : F} : 𝓜 ⊧ ∼φ ↔ ¬𝓜 ⊧ φ

class Tarski extends
  Semantics.Top M,

C1_dependencies.content:
/-- A set is a collection of elements of some type `α`.

Although `Set` is defined as `α → Prop`, this is an implementation detail which should not be
relied on. Instead, `setOf` and membership of a set (`∈`) should be used to convert between sets
and predicates.

import Foundation.Logic.LogicSymbol

/-!
# Basic definitions and properties of semantics-related notions

This file defines the semantics of formulas based on Tarski's truth definitions.
Also provides 𝓜 characterization of compactness.

## Main Definitions
* `LO.Semantics`: The realization of 𝓜 formula.
* `LO.Compact`: The semantic compactness of Foundation.

## Notation
* `𝓜 ⊧ φ`: a proposition that states `𝓜` satisfies `φ`.
* `𝓜 ⊧* T`: a proposition that states that `𝓜` satisfies each formulae in a set `T`.

-/

namespace LO

class Semantics (F : outParam Type*) (M : Type*) where
  Realize : M → F → Prop

variable {M : Type*} {F : Type*} [𝓢 : Semantics F M]

namespace Semantics

infix:45 " ⊧ " => Realize

section

variable [LogicalConnective F] (M)

protected class Top where
  realize_top (𝓜 : M) : 𝓜 ⊧ (⊤ : F)

protected class Bot where
  realize_bot (𝓜 : M) : ¬𝓜 ⊧ (⊥ : F)

protected class And where
  realize_and {𝓜 : M} {φ ψ : F} : 𝓜 ⊧ φ ⋏ ψ ↔ 𝓜 ⊧ φ ∧ 𝓜 ⊧ ψ

protected class Or where
  realize_or {𝓜 : M} {φ ψ : F} : 𝓜 ⊧ φ ⋎ ψ ↔ 𝓜 ⊧ φ ∨ 𝓜 ⊧ ψ

protected class Imp where
  realize_imp {𝓜 : M} {φ ψ : F} : 𝓜 ⊧ φ ➝ ψ ↔ (𝓜 ⊧ φ → 𝓜 ⊧ ψ)

protected class Not where
  realize_not {𝓜 : M} {φ : F} : 𝓜 ⊧ ∼φ ↔ ¬𝓜 ⊧ φ

class Tarski extends
  Semantics.Top M,
  Semantics.Bot M,
  Semantics.And M,
  Semantics.Or M,
  Semantics.Imp M,
  Semantics.Not M
  where


attribute [simp]
  Top.realize_top
  Bot.realize_bot
  Not.realize_not
  And.realize_and
  Or.realize_or
  Imp.realize_imp

variable {M}

variable [Tarski M]

variable {𝓜 : M}

@[simp] lemma realize_iff {φ ψ : F} :
    𝓜 ⊧ φ ⭤ ψ ↔ ((𝓜 ⊧ φ) ↔ (𝓜 ⊧ ψ)) := by
  simp [LogicalConnective.iff, iff_iff_implies_and_implies]

@[simp] lemma realize_list_conj {l : List F} :
    𝓜 ⊧ l.conj ↔ ∀ φ ∈ l, 𝓜 ⊧ φ := by induction l <;> simp [*]

@[simp] lemma realize_finset_conj {s : Finset F} :
    𝓜 ⊧ s.conj ↔ ∀ φ ∈ s, 𝓜 ⊧ φ := by simp [Finset.conj]

@[simp] lemma realize_list_disj {l : List F} :
    𝓜 ⊧ l.disj ↔ ∃ φ ∈ l, 𝓜 ⊧ φ := by induction l <;> simp [*]

@[simp] lemma realize_finset_disj {s : Finset F} :
    𝓜 ⊧ s.disj ↔ ∃ φ ∈ s, 𝓜 ⊧ φ := by simp [Finset.disj]

end

class RealizeSet (𝓜 : M) (T : Set F) : Prop where
  RealizeSet : ∀ ⦃f⦄, f ∈ T → Realize 𝓜 f

infix:45 " ⊧* " => RealizeSet

variable (M)

def Valid (f : F) : Prop := ∀ 𝓜 : M, 𝓜 ⊧ f

def Satisfiable (T : Set F) : Prop := ∃ 𝓜 : M, 𝓜 ⊧* T

def models (T : Set F) : Set M := {𝓜 | 𝓜 ⊧* T}

variable {M}

def theory (𝓜 : M) : Set F := {φ | 𝓜 ⊧ φ}

class Meaningful (𝓜 : M) : Prop where
  exists_unrealize : ∃ f, ¬𝓜 ⊧ f

instance [LogicalConnective F] [Semantics.Bot M] (𝓜 : M) : Meaningful 𝓜 := ⟨⟨⊥, by simp⟩⟩

  ⟨by rintro ⟨h⟩; exact h, fun h ↦ ⟨h⟩⟩

lemma not_meaningful_iff (𝓜 : M) : ¬Meaningful 𝓜 ↔ ∀ f, 𝓜 ⊧ f := by simp [meaningful_iff]

lemma realizeSet_iff {𝓜 : M} {T : Set F} : 𝓜 ⊧* T ↔ ∀ ⦃f⦄, f ∈ T → Realize 𝓜 f :=
  ⟨by rintro ⟨h⟩ f hf; exact h hf, by intro h; exact ⟨h⟩⟩

lemma not_satisfiable_finset [LogicalConnective F] [Tarski M] [DecidableEq F] (t : Finset F) :
    ¬Satisfiable M (t : Set F) ↔ Valid M (t.image (∼·)).disj := by
  simp [Satisfiable, realizeSet_iff, Valid, Finset.map_disj]

lemma satisfiableSet_iff_models_nonempty {T : Set F} :
    Satisfiable M T ↔ (models M T).Nonempty :=
  ⟨by rintro ⟨𝓜, h𝓜⟩; exact ⟨𝓜, h𝓜⟩, by rintro ⟨𝓜, h𝓜⟩; exact ⟨𝓜, h𝓜⟩⟩

namespace RealizeSet

lemma realize {T : Set F} (𝓜 : M) [𝓜 ⊧* T] (hf : f ∈ T) : 𝓜 ⊧ f :=
  RealizeSet hf

lemma of_subset {T U : Set F} {𝓜 : M} (h : 𝓜 ⊧* U) (ss : T ⊆ U) : 𝓜 ⊧* T :=
  ⟨fun _ hf => h.RealizeSet (ss hf)⟩

lemma of_subset' {T U : Set F} {𝓜 : M} [𝓜 ⊧* U] (ss : T ⊆ U) : 𝓜 ⊧* T :=
  of_subset (𝓜 := 𝓜) inferInstance ss

instance empty' (𝓜 : M) : 𝓜 ⊧* (∅ : Set F) := ⟨by simp⟩

@[simp] lemma empty (𝓜 : M) : 𝓜 ⊧* (∅ : Set F) := ⟨by simp⟩

@[simp] lemma singleton_iff {f : F} {𝓜 : M} :
    𝓜 ⊧* {f} ↔ 𝓜 ⊧ f := by simp [realizeSet_iff]

@[simp] lemma insert_iff {T : Set F} {f : F} {𝓜 : M} :
    𝓜 ⊧* insert f T ↔ 𝓜 ⊧ f ∧ 𝓜 ⊧* T := by
  exact?

/-!
# Basic definitions and properties of semantics-related notions

This file defines the semantics of formulas based on Tarski's truth definitions.
Also provides 𝓜 characterization of compactness.

## Main Definitions
* `LO.Semantics`: The realization of 𝓜 formula.
* `LO.Compact`: The semantic compactness of Foundation.

## Notation
* `𝓜 ⊧ φ`: a proposition that states `𝓜` satisfies `φ`.
* `𝓜 ⊧* T`: a proposition that states that `𝓜` satisfies each formulae in a set `T`.

-/

namespace LO

class Semantics (F : outParam Type*) (M : Type*) where
  Realize : M → F → Prop

variable {M : Type*} {F : Type*} [𝓢 : Semantics F M]

namespace Semantics

variable [LogicalConnective F] (M)

protected class Top where
  realize_top (𝓜 : M) : 𝓜 ⊧ (⊤ : F)

protected class Bot where
  realize_bot (𝓜 : M) : ¬𝓜 ⊧ (⊥ : F)

protected class And where
  realize_and {𝓜 : M} {φ ψ : F} : 𝓜 ⊧ φ ⋏ ψ ↔ 𝓜 ⊧ φ ∧ 𝓜 ⊧ ψ

protected class Or where
  realize_or {𝓜 : M} {φ ψ : F} : 𝓜 ⊧ φ ⋎ ψ ↔ 𝓜 ⊧ φ ∨ 𝓜 ⊧ ψ

protected class Imp where
  realize_imp {𝓜 : M} {φ ψ : F} : 𝓜 ⊧ φ ➝ ψ ↔ (𝓜 ⊧ φ → 𝓜 ⊧ ψ)

protected class Not where
  realize_not {𝓜 : M} {φ : F} : 𝓜 ⊧ ∼φ ↔ ¬𝓜 ⊧ φ

import Foundation.Logic.LogicSymbol

/-!
# Basic definitions and properties of semantics-related notions

This file defines the semantics of formulas based on Tarski's truth definitions.
Also provides 𝓜 characterization of compactness.

## Main Definitions
* `LO.Semantics`: The realization of 𝓜 formula.
* `LO.Compact`: The semantic compactness of Foundation.

## Notation
* `𝓜 ⊧ φ`: a proposition that states `𝓜` satisfies `φ`.
* `𝓜 ⊧* T`: a proposition that states that `𝓜` satisfies each formulae in a set `T`.

-/

namespace LO

class Semantics (F : outParam Type*) (M : Type*) where
  Realize : M → F → Prop

variable {M : Type*} {F : Type*} [𝓢 : Semantics F M]

namespace Semantics

infix:45 " ⊧ " => Realize

section

variable [LogicalConnective F] (M)

protected class Top where
  realize_top (𝓜 : M) : 𝓜 ⊧ (⊤ : F)

protected class Bot where
  realize_bot (𝓜 : M) : ¬𝓜 ⊧ (⊥ : F)

protected class And where
  realize_and {𝓜 : M} {φ ψ : F} : 𝓜 ⊧ φ ⋏ ψ ↔ 𝓜 ⊧ φ ∧ 𝓜 ⊧ ψ

protected class Or where
  realize_or {𝓜 : M} {φ ψ : F} : 𝓜 ⊧ φ ⋎ ψ ↔ 𝓜 ⊧ φ ∨ 𝓜 ⊧ ψ

protected class Imp where
  realize_imp {𝓜 : M} {φ ψ : F} : 𝓜 ⊧ φ ➝ ψ ↔ (𝓜 ⊧ φ → 𝓜 ⊧ ψ)

protected class Not where
  realize_not {𝓜 : M} {φ : F} : 𝓜 ⊧ ∼φ ↔ ¬𝓜 ⊧ φ

class Tarski extends
  Semantics.Top M,
  Semantics.Bot M,
  Semantics.And M,
  Semantics.Or M,
  Semantics.Imp M,
  Semantics.Not M
  where


attribute [simp]
  Top.realize_top
  Bot.realize_bot
  Not.realize_not
  And.realize_and
  Or.realize_or
  Imp.realize_imp

variable {M}

variable [Tarski M]

variable {𝓜 : M}

@[simp] lemma realize_iff {φ ψ : F} :
    𝓜 ⊧ φ ⭤ ψ ↔ ((𝓜 ⊧ φ) ↔ (𝓜 ⊧ ψ)) := by
  simp [LogicalConnective.iff, iff_iff_implies_and_implies]

@[simp] lemma realize_list_conj {l : List F} :
    𝓜 ⊧ l.conj ↔ ∀ φ ∈ l, 𝓜 ⊧ φ := by induction l <;> simp [*]

@[simp] lemma realize_finset_conj {s : Finset F} :
    𝓜 ⊧ s.conj ↔ ∀ φ ∈ s, 𝓜 ⊧ φ := by simp [Finset.conj]

@[simp] lemma realize_list_disj {l : List F} :
    𝓜 ⊧ l.disj ↔ ∃ φ ∈ l, 𝓜 ⊧ φ := by induction l <;> simp [*]

@[simp] lemma realize_finset_disj {s : Finset F} :
    𝓜 ⊧ s.disj ↔ ∃ φ ∈ s, 𝓜 ⊧ φ := by simp [Finset.disj]

end

class RealizeSet (𝓜 : M) (T : Set F) : Prop where
  RealizeSet : ∀ ⦃f⦄, f ∈ T → Realize 𝓜 f

infix:45 " ⊧* " => RealizeSet

variable (M)

def Valid (f : F) : Prop := ∀ 𝓜 : M, 𝓜 ⊧ f

def Satisfiable (T : Set F) : Prop := ∃ 𝓜 : M, 𝓜 ⊧* T

def models (T : Set F) : Set M := {𝓜 | 𝓜 ⊧* T}

variable {M}

def theory (𝓜 : M) : Set F := {φ | 𝓜 ⊧ φ}

class Meaningful (𝓜 : M) : Prop where
  exists_unrealize : ∃ f, ¬𝓜 ⊧ f

instance [LogicalConnective F] [Semantics.Bot M] (𝓜 : M) : Meaningful 𝓜 := ⟨⟨⊥, by simp⟩⟩

lemma meaningful_iff {𝓜 : M} : Meaningful 𝓜 ↔ ∃ f, ¬𝓜 ⊧ f :=
  ⟨by rintro ⟨h⟩; exact h, fun h ↦ ⟨h⟩⟩

lemma not_meaningful_iff (𝓜 : M) : ¬Meaningful 𝓜 ↔ ∀ f, 𝓜 ⊧ f := by simp [meaningful_iff]

lemma realizeSet_iff {𝓜 : M} {T : Set F} : 𝓜 ⊧* T ↔ ∀ ⦃f⦄, f ∈ T → Realize 𝓜 f :=
  ⟨by rintro ⟨h⟩ f hf; exact h hf, by intro h; exact ⟨h⟩⟩

lemma not_satisfiable_finset [LogicalConnective F] [Tarski M] [DecidableEq F] (t : Finset F) :
    ¬Satisfiable M (t : Set F) ↔ Valid M (t.image (∼·)).disj := by
  simp [Satisfiable, realizeSet_iff, Valid, Finset.map_disj]

lemma satisfiableSet_iff_models_nonempty {T : Set F} :
    Satisfiable M T ↔ (models M T).Nonempty :=
  ⟨by rintro ⟨𝓜, h𝓜⟩; exact ⟨𝓜, h𝓜⟩, by rintro ⟨𝓜, h𝓜⟩; exact ⟨𝓜, h𝓜⟩⟩

namespace RealizeSet

lemma realize {T : Set F} (𝓜 : M) [𝓜 ⊧* T] (hf : f ∈ T) : 𝓜 ⊧ f :=
  RealizeSet hf

lemma of_subset {T U : Set F} {𝓜 : M} (h : 𝓜 ⊧* U) (ss : T ⊆ U) : 𝓜 ⊧* T :=
  ⟨fun _ hf => h.RealizeSet (ss hf)⟩

lemma of_subset' {T U : Set F} {𝓜 : M} [𝓜 ⊧* U] (ss : T ⊆ U) : 𝓜 ⊧* T :=
  of_subset (𝓜 := 𝓜) inferInstance ss

instance empty' (𝓜 : M) : 𝓜 ⊧* (∅ : Set F) := ⟨by simp⟩

@[simp] lemma empty (𝓜 : M) : 𝓜 ⊧* (∅ : Set F) := ⟨by simp⟩

@[simp] lemma singleton_iff {f : F} {𝓜 : M} :
    𝓜 ⊧* {f} ↔ 𝓜 ⊧ f := by simp [realizeSet_iff]
annotation:

                           -/
    𝓜 ⊧* {f} ↔ 𝓜 ⊧ f := by simp [realizeSet_iff]

/-!
# Basic definitions and properties of semantics-related notions

This file defines the semantics of formulas based on Tarski's truth definitions.
Also provides 𝓜 characterization of compactness.

## Main Definitions
* `LO.Semantics`: The realization of 𝓜 formula.
* `LO.Compact`: The semantic compactness of Foundation.

## Notation
* `𝓜 ⊧ φ`: a proposition that states `𝓜` satisfies `φ`.
* `𝓜 ⊧* T`: a proposition that states that `𝓜` satisfies each formulae in a set `T`.

-/

namespace LO

class Semantics (F : outParam Type*) (M : Type*) where
  Realize : M → F → Prop

  realize_top (𝓜 : M) : 𝓜 ⊧ (⊤ : F)

protected class Bot where
  realize_bot (𝓜 : M) : ¬𝓜 ⊧ (⊥ : F)

protected class And where
  realize_and {𝓜 : M} {φ ψ : F} : 𝓜 ⊧ φ ⋏ ψ ↔ 𝓜 ⊧ φ ∧ 𝓜 ⊧ ψ

protected class Or where
  realize_or {𝓜 : M} {φ ψ : F} : 𝓜 ⊧ φ ⋎ ψ ↔ 𝓜 ⊧ φ ∨ 𝓜 ⊧ ψ

protected class Imp where
  realize_imp {𝓜 : M} {φ ψ : F} : 𝓜 ⊧ φ ➝ ψ ↔ (𝓜 ⊧ φ → 𝓜 ⊧ ψ)

protected class Not where
  realize_not {𝓜 : M} {φ : F} : 𝓜 ⊧ ∼φ ↔ ¬𝓜 ⊧ φ

import Foundation.Logic.LogicSymbol

/-!
# Basic definitions and properties of semantics-related notions

This file defines the semantics of formulas based on Tarski's truth definitions.
Also provides 𝓜 characterization of compactness.

## Main Definitions
* `LO.Semantics`: The realization of 𝓜 formula.
* `LO.Compact`: The semantic compactness of Foundation.

## Notation
* `𝓜 ⊧ φ`: a proposition that states `𝓜` satisfies `φ`.
* `𝓜 ⊧* T`: a proposition that states that `𝓜` satisfies each formulae in a set `T`.

-/

namespace LO

class Semantics (F : outParam Type*) (M : Type*) where
  Realize : M → F → Prop

variable {M : Type*} {F : Type*} [𝓢 : Semantics F M]

namespace Semantics

infix:45 " ⊧ " => Realize

section

variable [LogicalConnective F] (M)

protected class Top where
  realize_top (𝓜 : M) : 𝓜 ⊧ (⊤ : F)

protected class Bot where
  realize_bot (𝓜 : M) : ¬𝓜 ⊧ (⊥ : F)

protected class And where
  realize_and {𝓜 : M} {φ ψ : F} : 𝓜 ⊧ φ ⋏ ψ ↔ 𝓜 ⊧ φ ∧ 𝓜 ⊧ ψ

protected class Or where
  realize_or {𝓜 : M} {φ ψ : F} : 𝓜 ⊧ φ ⋎ ψ ↔ 𝓜 ⊧ φ ∨ 𝓜 ⊧ ψ

protected class Imp where
  realize_imp {𝓜 : M} {φ ψ : F} : 𝓜 ⊧ φ ➝ ψ ↔ (𝓜 ⊧ φ → 𝓜 ⊧ ψ)

protected class Not where
  realize_not {𝓜 : M} {φ : F} : 𝓜 ⊧ ∼φ ↔ ¬𝓜 ⊧ φ

class Tarski extends
  Semantics.Top M,
  Semantics.Bot M,
  Semantics.And M,
  Semantics.Or M,
  Semantics.Imp M,
  Semantics.Not M
  where


attribute [simp]
  Top.realize_top
  Bot.realize_bot
  Not.realize_not
  And.realize_and
  Or.realize_or
  Imp.realize_imp

variable {M}

variable [Tarski M]

variable {𝓜 : M}

@[simp] lemma realize_iff {φ ψ : F} :
    𝓜 ⊧ φ ⭤ ψ ↔ ((𝓜 ⊧ φ) ↔ (𝓜 ⊧ ψ)) := by
  simp [LogicalConnective.iff, iff_iff_implies_and_implies]

@[simp] lemma realize_list_conj {l : List F} :
    𝓜 ⊧ l.conj ↔ ∀ φ ∈ l, 𝓜 ⊧ φ := by induction l <;> simp [*]

@[simp] lemma realize_finset_conj {s : Finset F} :
    𝓜 ⊧ s.conj ↔ ∀ φ ∈ s, 𝓜 ⊧ φ := by simp [Finset.conj]

@[simp] lemma realize_list_disj {l : List F} :
    𝓜 ⊧ l.disj ↔ ∃ φ ∈ l, 𝓜 ⊧ φ := by induction l <;> simp [*]

@[simp] lemma realize_finset_disj {s : Finset F} :
    𝓜 ⊧ s.disj ↔ ∃ φ ∈ s, 𝓜 ⊧ φ := by simp [Finset.disj]

end

class RealizeSet (𝓜 : M) (T : Set F) : Prop where
  RealizeSet : ∀ ⦃f⦄, f ∈ T → Realize 𝓜 f

infix:45 " ⊧* " => RealizeSet

variable (M)

def Valid (f : F) : Prop := ∀ 𝓜 : M, 𝓜 ⊧ f

def Satisfiable (T : Set F) : Prop := ∃ 𝓜 : M, 𝓜 ⊧* T

def models (T : Set F) : Set M := {𝓜 | 𝓜 ⊧* T}

variable {M}

def theory (𝓜 : M) : Set F := {φ | 𝓜 ⊧ φ}

class Meaningful (𝓜 : M) : Prop where

lemma not_meaningful_iff (𝓜 : M) : ¬Meaningful 𝓜 ↔ ∀ f, 𝓜 ⊧ f := by simp [meaningful_iff]

lemma realizeSet_iff {𝓜 : M} {T : Set F} : 𝓜 ⊧* T ↔ ∀ ⦃f⦄, f ∈ T → Realize 𝓜 f :=
  ⟨by rintro ⟨h⟩ f hf; exact h hf, by intro h; exact ⟨h⟩⟩

lemma not_satisfiable_finset [LogicalConnective F] [Tarski M] [DecidableEq F] (t : Finset F) :
    ¬Satisfiable M (t : Set F) ↔ Valid M (t.image (∼·)).disj := by
  simp [Satisfiable, realizeSet_iff, Valid, Finset.map_disj]

lemma satisfiableSet_iff_models_nonempty {T : Set F} :
    Satisfiable M T ↔ (models M T).Nonempty :=
  ⟨by rintro ⟨𝓜, h𝓜⟩; exact ⟨𝓜, h𝓜⟩, by rintro ⟨𝓜, h𝓜⟩; exact ⟨𝓜, h𝓜⟩⟩

namespace RealizeSet

lemma realize {T : Set F} (𝓜 : M) [𝓜 ⊧* T] (hf : f ∈ T) : 𝓜 ⊧ f :=
  RealizeSet hf

lemma of_subset {T U : Set F} {𝓜 : M} (h : 𝓜 ⊧* U) (ss : T ⊆ U) : 𝓜 ⊧* T :=
  ⟨fun _ hf => h.RealizeSet (ss hf)⟩

lemma of_subset' {T U : Set F} {𝓜 : M} [𝓜 ⊧* U] (ss : T ⊆ U) : 𝓜 ⊧* T :=
  of_subset (𝓜 := 𝓜) inferInstance ss

instance empty' (𝓜 : M) : 𝓜 ⊧* (∅ : Set F) := ⟨by simp⟩

@[simp] lemma empty (𝓜 : M) : 𝓜 ⊧* (∅ : Set F) := ⟨by simp⟩

import Foundation.Logic.LogicSymbol

/-!
# Basic definitions and properties of semantics-related notions

This file defines the semantics of formulas based on Tarski's truth definitions.
Also provides 𝓜 characterization of compactness.

## Main Definitions
* `LO.Semantics`: The realization of 𝓜 formula.
* `LO.Compact`: The semantic compactness of Foundation.

## Notation
* `𝓜 ⊧ φ`: a proposition that states `𝓜` satisfies `φ`.
* `𝓜 ⊧* T`: a proposition that states that `𝓜` satisfies each formulae in a set `T`.

-/

namespace LO

class Semantics (F : outParam Type*) (M : Type*) where
  Realize : M → F → Prop

variable {M : Type*} {F : Type*} [𝓢 : Semantics F M]

namespace Semantics

infix:45 " ⊧ " => Realize

section

variable [LogicalConnective F] (M)

protected class Top where
  realize_top (𝓜 : M) : 𝓜 ⊧ (⊤ : F)

protected class Bot where
  realize_bot (𝓜 : M) : ¬𝓜 ⊧ (⊥ : F)

protected class And where
  realize_and {𝓜 : M} {φ ψ : F} : 𝓜 ⊧ φ ⋏ ψ ↔ 𝓜 ⊧ φ ∧ 𝓜 ⊧ ψ

protected class Or where
  realize_or {𝓜 : M} {φ ψ : F} : 𝓜 ⊧ φ ⋎ ψ ↔ 𝓜 ⊧ φ ∨ 𝓜 ⊧ ψ

protected class Imp where
  realize_imp {𝓜 : M} {φ ψ : F} : 𝓜 ⊧ φ ➝ ψ ↔ (𝓜 ⊧ φ → 𝓜 ⊧ ψ)

protected class Not where
  realize_not {𝓜 : M} {φ : F} : 𝓜 ⊧ ∼φ ↔ ¬𝓜 ⊧ φ

class Tarski extends
  Semantics.Top M,
  Semantics.Bot M,
  Semantics.And M,
  Semantics.Or M,
  Semantics.Imp M,
  Semantics.Not M
  where


attribute [simp]
  Top.realize_top
  Bot.realize_bot
  Not.realize_not
  And.realize_and
  Or.realize_or
  Imp.realize_imp

variable {M}

import Foundation.Logic.LogicSymbol

/-!
# Basic definitions and properties of semantics-related notions

This file defines the semantics of formulas based on Tarski's truth definitions.
Also provides 𝓜 characterization of compactness.

## Main Definitions
* `LO.Semantics`: The realization of 𝓜 formula.
* `LO.Compact`: The semantic compactness of Foundation.

## Notation
* `𝓜 ⊧ φ`: a proposition that states `𝓜` satisfies `φ`.
* `𝓜 ⊧* T`: a proposition that states that `𝓜` satisfies each formulae in a set `T`.

-/

namespace LO

class Semantics (F : outParam Type*) (M : Type*) where
  Realize : M → F → Prop

variable {M : Type*} {F : Type*} [𝓢 : Semantics F M]

namespace Semantics

infix:45 " ⊧ " => Realize

variable [LogicalConnective F] (M)

protected class Top where
  realize_top (𝓜 : M) : 𝓜 ⊧ (⊤ : F)

protected class Bot where
  realize_bot (𝓜 : M) : ¬𝓜 ⊧ (⊥ : F)

protected class And where
  realize_and {𝓜 : M} {φ ψ : F} : 𝓜 ⊧ φ ⋏ ψ ↔ 𝓜 ⊧ φ ∧ 𝓜 ⊧ ψ

protected class Or where
  realize_or {𝓜 : M} {φ ψ : F} : 𝓜 ⊧ φ ⋎ ψ ↔ 𝓜 ⊧ φ ∨ 𝓜 ⊧ ψ

protected class Imp where
  realize_imp {𝓜 : M} {φ ψ : F} : 𝓜 ⊧ φ ➝ ψ ↔ (𝓜 ⊧ φ → 𝓜 ⊧ ψ)

protected class Not where
  realize_not {𝓜 : M} {φ : F} : 𝓜 ⊧ ∼φ ↔ ¬𝓜 ⊧ φ

class Tarski extends
  Semantics.Top M,
  Semantics.Bot M,
  Semantics.And M,
  Semantics.Or M,
  Semantics.Imp M,
  Semantics.Not M
  where


attribute [simp]

  Bot.realize_bot
  Not.realize_not
  And.realize_and
  Or.realize_or
  Imp.realize_imp

import Foundation.Logic.LogicSymbol

/-!
# Basic definitions and properties of semantics-related notions

This file defines the semantics of formulas based on Tarski's truth definitions.
Also provides 𝓜 characterization of compactness.

## Main Definitions
* `LO.Semantics`: The realization of 𝓜 formula.
* `LO.Compact`: The semantic compactness of Foundation.

## Notation
* `𝓜 ⊧ φ`: a proposition that states `𝓜` satisfies `φ`.
* `𝓜 ⊧* T`: a proposition that states that `𝓜` satisfies each formulae in a set `T`.

-/

namespace LO

class Semantics (F : outParam Type*) (M : Type*) where
  Realize : M → F → Prop

variable {M : Type*} {F : Type*} [𝓢 : Semantics F M]

namespace Semantics

infix:45 " ⊧ " => Realize

section

variable [LogicalConnective F] (M)

/-!
# Basic definitions and properties of semantics-related notions

This file defines the semantics of formulas based on Tarski's truth definitions.
Also provides 𝓜 characterization of compactness.

## Main Definitions
* `LO.Semantics`: The realization of 𝓜 formula.
* `LO.Compact`: The semantic compactness of Foundation.

## Notation
* `𝓜 ⊧ φ`: a proposition that states `𝓜` satisfies `φ`.
* `𝓜 ⊧* T`: a proposition that states that `𝓜` satisfies each formulae in a set `T`.

-/

  Realize : M → F → Prop

/--
`inferInstance` synthesizes a value of any target type by typeclass
inference. This function has the same type signature as the identity
function, but the square brackets on the `[i : α]` argument means that it will
attempt to construct this argument by typeclass inference. (This will fail if
`α` is not a `class`.) Example:
```
#check (inferInstance : Inhabited Nat) -- Inhabited Nat

def foo : Inhabited (Nat × Nat) :=
  inferInstance

example : foo.default = (default, default) :=
  rfl
```
-/

## Main Definitions
* `LO.Semantics`: The realization of 𝓜 formula.
* `LO.Compact`: The semantic compactness of Foundation.

## Notation
* `𝓜 ⊧ φ`: a proposition that states `𝓜` satisfies `φ`.
* `𝓜 ⊧* T`: a proposition that states that `𝓜` satisfies each formulae in a set `T`.

-/

namespace LO

class Semantics (F : outParam Type*) (M : Type*) where
  Realize : M → F → Prop

variable {M : Type*} {F : Type*} [𝓢 : Semantics F M]

namespace Semantics

infix:45 " ⊧ " => Realize

section

variable [LogicalConnective F] (M)

protected class Top where
  realize_top (𝓜 : M) : 𝓜 ⊧ (⊤ : F)

protected class Bot where
  realize_bot (𝓜 : M) : ¬𝓜 ⊧ (⊥ : F)

protected class And where
  realize_and {𝓜 : M} {φ ψ : F} : 𝓜 ⊧ φ ⋏ ψ ↔ 𝓜 ⊧ φ ∧ 𝓜 ⊧ ψ

protected class Or where
  realize_or {𝓜 : M} {φ ψ : F} : 𝓜 ⊧ φ ⋎ ψ ↔ 𝓜 ⊧ φ ∨ 𝓜 ⊧ ψ

protected class Imp where
  realize_imp {𝓜 : M} {φ ψ : F} : 𝓜 ⊧ φ ➝ ψ ↔ (𝓜 ⊧ φ → 𝓜 ⊧ ψ)

protected class Not where
  realize_not {𝓜 : M} {φ : F} : 𝓜 ⊧ ∼φ ↔ ¬𝓜 ⊧ φ

class Tarski extends
  Semantics.Top M,
  Semantics.Bot M,
  Semantics.And M,
  Semantics.Or M,
  Semantics.Imp M,
  Semantics.Not M
  where


attribute [simp]
  Top.realize_top
  Bot.realize_bot
  Not.realize_not
  And.realize_and
  Or.realize_or
  Imp.realize_imp

variable {M}

variable [Tarski M]

variable {𝓜 : M}

@[simp] lemma realize_iff {φ ψ : F} :
    𝓜 ⊧ φ ⭤ ψ ↔ ((𝓜 ⊧ φ) ↔ (𝓜 ⊧ ψ)) := by
  simp [LogicalConnective.iff, iff_iff_implies_and_implies]

@[simp] lemma realize_list_conj {l : List F} :
    𝓜 ⊧ l.conj ↔ ∀ φ ∈ l, 𝓜 ⊧ φ := by induction l <;> simp [*]

@[simp] lemma realize_finset_conj {s : Finset F} :
    𝓜 ⊧ s.conj ↔ ∀ φ ∈ s, 𝓜 ⊧ φ := by simp [Finset.conj]

@[simp] lemma realize_list_disj {l : List F} :
    𝓜 ⊧ l.disj ↔ ∃ φ ∈ l, 𝓜 ⊧ φ := by induction l <;> simp [*]

@[simp] lemma realize_finset_disj {s : Finset F} :
    𝓜 ⊧ s.disj ↔ ∃ φ ∈ s, 𝓜 ⊧ φ := by simp [Finset.disj]

end

class RealizeSet (𝓜 : M) (T : Set F) : Prop where
  RealizeSet : ∀ ⦃f⦄, f ∈ T → Realize 𝓜 f

variable (M)

def Valid (f : F) : Prop := ∀ 𝓜 : M, 𝓜 ⊧ f

def Satisfiable (T : Set F) : Prop := ∃ 𝓜 : M, 𝓜 ⊧* T

def models (T : Set F) : Set M := {𝓜 | 𝓜 ⊧* T}

variable {M}

def theory (𝓜 : M) : Set F := {φ | 𝓜 ⊧ φ}

class Meaningful (𝓜 : M) : Prop where
  exists_unrealize : ∃ f, ¬𝓜 ⊧ f

instance [LogicalConnective F] [Semantics.Bot M] (𝓜 : M) : Meaningful 𝓜 := ⟨⟨⊥, by simp⟩⟩

lemma meaningful_iff {𝓜 : M} : Meaningful 𝓜 ↔ ∃ f, ¬𝓜 ⊧ f :=
  ⟨by rintro ⟨h⟩; exact h, fun h ↦ ⟨h⟩⟩

lemma not_meaningful_iff (𝓜 : M) : ¬Meaningful 𝓜 ↔ ∀ f, 𝓜 ⊧ f := by simp [meaningful_iff]

lemma realizeSet_iff {𝓜 : M} {T : Set F} : 𝓜 ⊧* T ↔ ∀ ⦃f⦄, f ∈ T → Realize 𝓜 f :=
  ⟨by rintro ⟨h⟩ f hf; exact h hf, by intro h; exact ⟨h⟩⟩

lemma not_satisfiable_finset [LogicalConnective F] [Tarski M] [DecidableEq F] (t : Finset F) :
    ¬Satisfiable M (t : Set F) ↔ Valid M (t.image (∼·)).disj := by
  simp [Satisfiable, realizeSet_iff, Valid, Finset.map_disj]

lemma satisfiableSet_iff_models_nonempty {T : Set F} :
    Satisfiable M T ↔ (models M T).Nonempty :=
  ⟨by rintro ⟨𝓜, h𝓜⟩; exact ⟨𝓜, h𝓜⟩, by rintro ⟨𝓜, h𝓜⟩; exact ⟨𝓜, h𝓜⟩⟩

namespace RealizeSet

lemma realize {T : Set F} (𝓜 : M) [𝓜 ⊧* T] (hf : f ∈ T) : 𝓜 ⊧ f := by exact?

import Foundation.Logic.LogicSymbol

/-!
# Basic definitions and properties of semantics-related notions

This file defines the semantics of formulas based on Tarski's truth definitions.
Also provides 𝓜 characterization of compactness.

## Main Definitions
* `LO.Semantics`: The realization of 𝓜 formula.
* `LO.Compact`: The semantic compactness of Foundation.

## Notation
* `𝓜 ⊧ φ`: a proposition that states `𝓜` satisfies `φ`.
* `𝓜 ⊧* T`: a proposition that states that `𝓜` satisfies each formulae in a set `T`.

-/

namespace LO

class Semantics (F : outParam Type*) (M : Type*) where
  Realize : M → F → Prop

variable {M : Type*} {F : Type*} [𝓢 : Semantics F M]

namespace Semantics

infix:45 " ⊧ " => Realize

section

variable [LogicalConnective F] (M)

protected class Top where
  realize_top (𝓜 : M) : 𝓜 ⊧ (⊤ : F)

protected class Bot where
  realize_bot (𝓜 : M) : ¬𝓜 ⊧ (⊥ : F)

protected class And where
  realize_and {𝓜 : M} {φ ψ : F} : 𝓜 ⊧ φ ⋏ ψ ↔ 𝓜 ⊧ φ ∧ 𝓜 ⊧ ψ

protected class Or where
  realize_or {𝓜 : M} {φ ψ : F} : 𝓜 ⊧ φ ⋎ ψ ↔ 𝓜 ⊧ φ ∨ 𝓜 ⊧ ψ

# Basic definitions and properties of semantics-related notions

Also provides 𝓜 characterization of compactness.

## Main Definitions
* `LO.Semantics`: The realization of 𝓜 formula.
* `LO.Compact`: The semantic compactness of Foundation.

## Notation
* `𝓜 ⊧ φ`: a proposition that states `𝓜` satisfies `φ`.
* `𝓜 ⊧* T`: a proposition that states that `𝓜` satisfies each formulae in a set `T`.

-/

import Foundation.Logic.LogicSymbol

/-!
# Basic definitions and properties of semantics-related notions

This file defines the semantics of formulas based on Tarski's truth definitions.
Also provides 𝓜 characterization of compactness.

## Main Definitions
* `LO.Semantics`: The realization of 𝓜 formula.
* `LO.Compact`: The semantic compactness of Foundation.

## Notation
* `𝓜 ⊧ φ`: a proposition that states `𝓜` satisfies `φ`.
* `𝓜 ⊧* T`: a proposition that states that `𝓜` satisfies each formulae in a set `T`.

-/

namespace LO

class Semantics (F : outParam Type*) (M : Type*) where
  Realize : M → F → Prop

variable {M : Type*} {F : Type*} [𝓢 : Semantics F M]

namespace Semantics

infix:45 " ⊧ " => Realize

section

variable [LogicalConnective F] (M)

protected class Top where
  realize_top (𝓜 : M) : 𝓜 ⊧ (⊤ : F)

protected class Bot where
  realize_bot (𝓜 : M) : ¬𝓜 ⊧ (⊥ : F)

protected class And where
  realize_and {𝓜 : M} {φ ψ : F} : 𝓜 ⊧ φ ⋏ ψ ↔ 𝓜 ⊧ φ ∧ 𝓜 ⊧ ψ

protected class Or where
  realize_or {𝓜 : M} {φ ψ : F} : 𝓜 ⊧ φ ⋎ ψ ↔ 𝓜 ⊧ φ ∨ 𝓜 ⊧ ψ

protected class Imp where
  realize_imp {𝓜 : M} {φ ψ : F} : 𝓜 ⊧ φ ➝ ψ ↔ (𝓜 ⊧ φ → 𝓜 ⊧ ψ)

protected class Not where
  realize_not {𝓜 : M} {φ : F} : 𝓜 ⊧ ∼φ ↔ ¬𝓜 ⊧ φ

class Tarski extends
  Semantics.Top M,
  Semantics.Bot M,
  Semantics.And M,
  Semantics.Or M,
  Semantics.Imp M,
  Semantics.Not M
  where


attribute [simp]
  Top.realize_top
  Bot.realize_bot
  Not.realize_not
  And.realize_and
  Or.realize_or
  Imp.realize_imp

variable {M}

variable [Tarski M]

variable {𝓜 : M}

@[simp] lemma realize_iff {φ ψ : F} :
    𝓜 ⊧ φ ⭤ ψ ↔ ((𝓜 ⊧ φ) ↔ (𝓜 ⊧ ψ)) := by
  simp [LogicalConnective.iff, iff_iff_implies_and_implies]

@[simp] lemma realize_list_conj {l : List F} :
    𝓜 ⊧ l.conj ↔ ∀ φ ∈ l, 𝓜 ⊧ φ := by induction l <;> simp [*]

@[simp] lemma realize_finset_conj {s : Finset F} :
    𝓜 ⊧ s.conj ↔ ∀ φ ∈ s, 𝓜 ⊧ φ := by simp [Finset.conj]

@[simp] lemma realize_list_disj {l : List F} :
    𝓜 ⊧ l.disj ↔ ∃ φ ∈ l, 𝓜 ⊧ φ := by induction l <;> simp [*]

@[simp] lemma realize_finset_disj {s : Finset F} :
    𝓜 ⊧ s.disj ↔ ∃ φ ∈ s, 𝓜 ⊧ φ := by simp [Finset.disj]

end

  RealizeSet : ∀ ⦃f⦄, f ∈ T → Realize 𝓜 f

variable (M)

def Valid (f : F) : Prop := ∀ 𝓜 : M, 𝓜 ⊧ f

def Satisfiable (T : Set F) : Prop := ∃ 𝓜 : M, 𝓜 ⊧* T

def models (T : Set F) : Set M := {𝓜 | 𝓜 ⊧* T}

variable {M}

import Foundation.Logic.LogicSymbol

/-!
# Basic definitions and properties of semantics-related notions

This file defines the semantics of formulas based on Tarski's truth definitions.
Also provides 𝓜 characterization of compactness.

## Main Definitions
* `LO.Semantics`: The realization of 𝓜 formula.
* `LO.Compact`: The semantic compactness of Foundation.

## Notation
* `𝓜 ⊧ φ`: a proposition that states `𝓜` satisfies `φ`.
* `𝓜 ⊧* T`: a proposition that states that `𝓜` satisfies each formulae in a set `T`.

-/

namespace LO

class Semantics (F : outParam Type*) (M : Type*) where
  Realize : M → F → Prop

variable {M : Type*} {F : Type*} [𝓢 : Semantics F M]

namespace Semantics

infix:45 " ⊧ " => Realize

section

variable [LogicalConnective F] (M)

protected class Top where
  realize_top (𝓜 : M) : 𝓜 ⊧ (⊤ : F)

protected class Bot where
  realize_bot (𝓜 : M) : ¬𝓜 ⊧ (⊥ : F)

protected class And where
  realize_and {𝓜 : M} {φ ψ : F} : 𝓜 ⊧ φ ⋏ ψ ↔ 𝓜 ⊧ φ ∧ 𝓜 ⊧ ψ

protected class Or where
  realize_or {𝓜 : M} {φ ψ : F} : 𝓜 ⊧ φ ⋎ ψ ↔ 𝓜 ⊧ φ ∨ 𝓜 ⊧ ψ

protected class Imp where
  realize_imp {𝓜 : M} {φ ψ : F} : 𝓜 ⊧ φ ➝ ψ ↔ (𝓜 ⊧ φ → 𝓜 ⊧ ψ)

protected class Not where
  realize_not {𝓜 : M} {φ : F} : 𝓜 ⊧ ∼φ ↔ ¬𝓜 ⊧ φ

class Tarski extends
  Semantics.Top M,
  Semantics.Bot M,
  Semantics.And M,
  Semantics.Or M,
  Semantics.Imp M,
  Semantics.Not M
  where


attribute [simp]
  Top.realize_top
  Bot.realize_bot
  Not.realize_not
  And.realize_and
  Or.realize_or
  Imp.realize_imp

variable {M}

variable [Tarski M]

variable {𝓜 : M}

@[simp] lemma realize_iff {φ ψ : F} :
    𝓜 ⊧ φ ⭤ ψ ↔ ((𝓜 ⊧ φ) ↔ (𝓜 ⊧ ψ)) := by
  simp [LogicalConnective.iff, iff_iff_implies_and_implies]

@[simp] lemma realize_list_conj {l : List F} :
    𝓜 ⊧ l.conj ↔ ∀ φ ∈ l, 𝓜 ⊧ φ := by induction l <;> simp [*]

@[simp] lemma realize_finset_conj {s : Finset F} :
    𝓜 ⊧ s.conj ↔ ∀ φ ∈ s, 𝓜 ⊧ φ := by simp [Finset.conj]

@[simp] lemma realize_list_disj {l : List F} :
    𝓜 ⊧ l.disj ↔ ∃ φ ∈ l, 𝓜 ⊧ φ := by induction l <;> simp [*]

@[simp] lemma realize_finset_disj {s : Finset F} :
    𝓜 ⊧ s.disj ↔ ∃ φ ∈ s, 𝓜 ⊧ φ := by simp [Finset.disj]

end

class RealizeSet (𝓜 : M) (T : Set F) : Prop where
  RealizeSet : ∀ ⦃f⦄, f ∈ T → Realize 𝓜 f

infix:45 " ⊧* " => RealizeSet

variable (M)

def Valid (f : F) : Prop := ∀ 𝓜 : M, 𝓜 ⊧ f

def Satisfiable (T : Set F) : Prop := ∃ 𝓜 : M, 𝓜 ⊧* T

def models (T : Set F) : Set M := {𝓜 | 𝓜 ⊧* T}

variable {M}

def theory (𝓜 : M) : Set F := {φ | 𝓜 ⊧ φ}

class Meaningful (𝓜 : M) : Prop where
  exists_unrealize : ∃ f, ¬𝓜 ⊧ f

instance [LogicalConnective F] [Semantics.Bot M] (𝓜 : M) : Meaningful 𝓜 := ⟨⟨⊥, by simp⟩⟩

lemma meaningful_iff {𝓜 : M} : Meaningful 𝓜 ↔ ∃ f, ¬𝓜 ⊧ f :=
  ⟨by rintro ⟨h⟩; exact h, fun h ↦ ⟨h⟩⟩

lemma not_meaningful_iff (𝓜 : M) : ¬Meaningful 𝓜 ↔ ∀ f, 𝓜 ⊧ f := by simp [meaningful_iff]

lemma realizeSet_iff {𝓜 : M} {T : Set F} : 𝓜 ⊧* T ↔ ∀ ⦃f⦄, f ∈ T → Realize 𝓜 f :=
  ⟨by rintro ⟨h⟩ f hf; exact h hf, by intro h; exact ⟨h⟩⟩

lemma not_satisfiable_finset [LogicalConnective F] [Tarski M] [DecidableEq F] (t : Finset F) :
    ¬Satisfiable M (t : Set F) ↔ Valid M (t.image (∼·)).disj := by
  simp [Satisfiable, realizeSet_iff, Valid, Finset.map_disj]

/-!
# Basic definitions and properties of semantics-related notions

This file defines the semantics of formulas based on Tarski's truth definitions.
Also provides 𝓜 characterization of compactness.

## Main Definitions
* `LO.Semantics`: The realization of 𝓜 formula.
* `LO.Compact`: The semantic compactness of Foundation.

## Notation
* `𝓜 ⊧ φ`: a proposition that states `𝓜` satisfies `φ`.
* `𝓜 ⊧* T`: a proposition that states that `𝓜` satisfies each formulae in a set `T`.

-/

namespace LO

class Semantics (F : outParam Type*) (M : Type*) where
  Realize : M → F → Prop

variable {M : Type*} {F : Type*} [𝓢 : Semantics F M]

namespace Semantics

infix:45 " ⊧ " => Realize

section

variable [LogicalConnective F] (M)

protected class Top where
  realize_top (𝓜 : M) : 𝓜 ⊧ (⊤ : F)

protected class Bot where
  realize_bot (𝓜 : M) : ¬𝓜 ⊧ (⊥ : F)

protected class And where
  realize_and {𝓜 : M} {φ ψ : F} : 𝓜 ⊧ φ ⋏ ψ ↔ 𝓜 ⊧ φ ∧ 𝓜 ⊧ ψ

protected class Or where
  realize_or {𝓜 : M} {φ ψ : F} : 𝓜 ⊧ φ ⋎ ψ ↔ 𝓜 ⊧ φ ∨ 𝓜 ⊧ ψ

protected class Imp where
  realize_imp {𝓜 : M} {φ ψ : F} : 𝓜 ⊧ φ ➝ ψ ↔ (𝓜 ⊧ φ → 𝓜 ⊧ ψ)

protected class Not where
  realize_not {𝓜 : M} {φ : F} : 𝓜 ⊧ ∼φ ↔ ¬𝓜 ⊧ φ

class Tarski extends
  Semantics.Top M,
  Semantics.Bot M,
  Semantics.And M,
  Semantics.Or M,
  Semantics.Imp M,
  Semantics.Not M
  where


attribute [simp]
  Top.realize_top
  Bot.realize_bot
  Not.realize_not
  And.realize_and
  Or.realize_or
  Imp.realize_imp

variable [Tarski M]

variable {𝓜 : M}

@[simp] lemma realize_iff {φ ψ : F} :
    𝓜 ⊧ φ ⭤ ψ ↔ ((𝓜 ⊧ φ) ↔ (𝓜 ⊧ ψ)) := by
  simp [LogicalConnective.iff, iff_iff_implies_and_implies]

@[simp] lemma realize_list_conj {l : List F} :
    𝓜 ⊧ l.conj ↔ ∀ φ ∈ l, 𝓜 ⊧ φ := by induction l <;> simp [*]

@[simp] lemma realize_finset_conj {s : Finset F} :
    𝓜 ⊧ s.conj ↔ ∀ φ ∈ s, 𝓜 ⊧ φ := by simp [Finset.conj]

@[simp] lemma realize_list_disj {l : List F} :
    𝓜 ⊧ l.disj ↔ ∃ φ ∈ l, 𝓜 ⊧ φ := by induction l <;> simp [*]

@[simp] lemma realize_finset_disj {s : Finset F} :
    𝓜 ⊧ s.disj ↔ ∃ φ ∈ s, 𝓜 ⊧ φ := by simp [Finset.disj]

/-!
# Basic definitions and properties of semantics-related notions

This file defines the semantics of formulas based on Tarski's truth definitions.
Also provides 𝓜 characterization of compactness.

## Main Definitions
* `LO.Semantics`: The realization of 𝓜 formula.
* `LO.Compact`: The semantic compactness of Foundation.

## Notation
* `𝓜 ⊧ φ`: a proposition that states `𝓜` satisfies `φ`.
* `𝓜 ⊧* T`: a proposition that states that `𝓜` satisfies each formulae in a set `T`.

-/

namespace LO

class Semantics (F : outParam Type*) (M : Type*) where
  Realize : M → F → Prop

variable {M : Type*} {F : Type*} [𝓢 : Semantics F M]

namespace Semantics

infix:45 " ⊧ " => Realize

  realize_top (𝓜 : M) : 𝓜 ⊧ (⊤ : F)

protected class Bot where
  realize_bot (𝓜 : M) : ¬𝓜 ⊧ (⊥ : F)

protected class And where
  realize_and {𝓜 : M} {φ ψ : F} : 𝓜 ⊧ φ ⋏ ψ ↔ 𝓜 ⊧ φ ∧ 𝓜 ⊧ ψ

protected class Or where
  realize_or {𝓜 : M} {φ ψ : F} : 𝓜 ⊧ φ ⋎ ψ ↔ 𝓜 ⊧ φ ∨ 𝓜 ⊧ ψ

protected class Imp where
  realize_imp {𝓜 : M} {φ ψ : F} : 𝓜 ⊧ φ ➝ ψ ↔ (𝓜 ⊧ φ → 𝓜 ⊧ ψ)

protected class Not where
  realize_not {𝓜 : M} {φ : F} : 𝓜 ⊧ ∼φ ↔ ¬𝓜 ⊧ φ

class Tarski extends
  Semantics.Top M,

/-!
# Basic definitions and properties of semantics-related notions

This file defines the semantics of formulas based on Tarski's truth definitions.
Also provides 𝓜 characterization of compactness.

## Main Definitions
* `LO.Semantics`: The realization of 𝓜 formula.
* `LO.Compact`: The semantic compactness of Foundation.

## Notation
* `𝓜 ⊧ φ`: a proposition that states `𝓜` satisfies `φ`.
* `𝓜 ⊧* T`: a proposition that states that `𝓜` satisfies each formulae in a set `T`.

-/

namespace LO

class Semantics (F : outParam Type*) (M : Type*) where
  Realize : M → F → Prop

variable {M : Type*} {F : Type*} [𝓢 : Semantics F M]

namespace Semantics

infix:45 " ⊧ " => Realize

section

variable [LogicalConnective F] (M)

protected class Top where
  realize_top (𝓜 : M) : 𝓜 ⊧ (⊤ : F)

protected class Bot where
  realize_bot (𝓜 : M) : ¬𝓜 ⊧ (⊥ : F)

protected class And where
  realize_and {𝓜 : M} {φ ψ : F} : 𝓜 ⊧ φ ⋏ ψ ↔ 𝓜 ⊧ φ ∧ 𝓜 ⊧ ψ

protected class Or where
  realize_or {𝓜 : M} {φ ψ : F} : 𝓜 ⊧ φ ⋎ ψ ↔ 𝓜 ⊧ φ ∨ 𝓜 ⊧ ψ

protected class Imp where
  realize_imp {𝓜 : M} {φ ψ : F} : 𝓜 ⊧ φ ➝ ψ ↔ (𝓜 ⊧ φ → 𝓜 ⊧ ψ)

protected class Not where
  realize_not {𝓜 : M} {φ : F} : 𝓜 ⊧ ∼φ ↔ ¬𝓜 ⊧ φ

class Tarski extends
  Semantics.Top M,
  Semantics.Bot M,
  Semantics.And M,
  Semantics.Or M,
  Semantics.Imp M,
  Semantics.Not M
  where


attribute [simp]
  Top.realize_top
  Bot.realize_bot
  Not.realize_not
  And.realize_and
  Or.realize_or
  Imp.realize_imp

variable {M}

variable [Tarski M]

variable {𝓜 : M}

@[simp] lemma realize_iff {φ ψ : F} :
    𝓜 ⊧ φ ⭤ ψ ↔ ((𝓜 ⊧ φ) ↔ (𝓜 ⊧ ψ)) := by
  simp [LogicalConnective.iff, iff_iff_implies_and_implies]

@[simp] lemma realize_list_conj {l : List F} :
    𝓜 ⊧ l.conj ↔ ∀ φ ∈ l, 𝓜 ⊧ φ := by induction l <;> simp [*]

@[simp] lemma realize_finset_conj {s : Finset F} :
    𝓜 ⊧ s.conj ↔ ∀ φ ∈ s, 𝓜 ⊧ φ := by simp [Finset.conj]

@[simp] lemma realize_list_disj {l : List F} :
    𝓜 ⊧ l.disj ↔ ∃ φ ∈ l, 𝓜 ⊧ φ := by induction l <;> simp [*]

@[simp] lemma realize_finset_disj {s : Finset F} :
    𝓜 ⊧ s.disj ↔ ∃ φ ∈ s, 𝓜 ⊧ φ := by simp [Finset.disj]

end

  RealizeSet : ∀ ⦃f⦄, f ∈ T → Realize 𝓜 f

import Foundation.Logic.LogicSymbol

/-!
# Basic definitions and properties of semantics-related notions

This file defines the semantics of formulas based on Tarski's truth definitions.
Also provides 𝓜 characterization of compactness.

## Main Definitions
* `LO.Semantics`: The realization of 𝓜 formula.
* `LO.Compact`: The semantic compactness of Foundation.

## Notation
* `𝓜 ⊧ φ`: a proposition that states `𝓜` satisfies `φ`.
* `𝓜 ⊧* T`: a proposition that states that `𝓜` satisfies each formulae in a set `T`.

-/

namespace LO

class Semantics (F : outParam Type*) (M : Type*) where
  Realize : M → F → Prop

variable {M : Type*} {F : Type*} [𝓢 : Semantics F M]

namespace Semantics

infix:45 " ⊧ " => Realize

section

variable [LogicalConnective F] (M)

protected class Top where
  realize_top (𝓜 : M) : 𝓜 ⊧ (⊤ : F)

protected class Bot where
  realize_bot (𝓜 : M) : ¬𝓜 ⊧ (⊥ : F)

protected class And where
  realize_and {𝓜 : M} {φ ψ : F} : 𝓜 ⊧ φ ⋏ ψ ↔ 𝓜 ⊧ φ ∧ 𝓜 ⊧ ψ

protected class Or where
  realize_or {𝓜 : M} {φ ψ : F} : 𝓜 ⊧ φ ⋎ ψ ↔ 𝓜 ⊧ φ ∨ 𝓜 ⊧ ψ

protected class Imp where
  realize_imp {𝓜 : M} {φ ψ : F} : 𝓜 ⊧ φ ➝ ψ ↔ (𝓜 ⊧ φ → 𝓜 ⊧ ψ)

protected class Not where
  realize_not {𝓜 : M} {φ : F} : 𝓜 ⊧ ∼φ ↔ ¬𝓜 ⊧ φ

class Tarski extends
  Semantics.Top M,
  Semantics.Bot M,
  Semantics.And M,
  Semantics.Or M,
  Semantics.Imp M,
  Semantics.Not M
  where


attribute [simp]
  Top.realize_top
  Bot.realize_bot
  Not.realize_not
  And.realize_and
  Or.realize_or

import Foundation.Logic.LogicSymbol

/-!
# Basic definitions and properties of semantics-related notions

This file defines the semantics of formulas based on Tarski's truth definitions.
Also provides 𝓜 characterization of compactness.

## Main Definitions
* `LO.Semantics`: The realization of 𝓜 formula.
* `LO.Compact`: The semantic compactness of Foundation.

## Notation
* `𝓜 ⊧ φ`: a proposition that states `𝓜` satisfies `φ`.
* `𝓜 ⊧* T`: a proposition that states that `𝓜` satisfies each formulae in a set `T`.

-/

namespace LO

class Semantics (F : outParam Type*) (M : Type*) where
  Realize : M → F → Prop

variable {M : Type*} {F : Type*} [𝓢 : Semantics F M]

namespace Semantics

infix:45 " ⊧ " => Realize

section

variable [LogicalConnective F] (M)

protected class Top where
  realize_top (𝓜 : M) : 𝓜 ⊧ (⊤ : F)

protected class Bot where
  realize_bot (𝓜 : M) : ¬𝓜 ⊧ (⊥ : F)

protected class And where
  realize_and {𝓜 : M} {φ ψ : F} : 𝓜 ⊧ φ ⋏ ψ ↔ 𝓜 ⊧ φ ∧ 𝓜 ⊧ ψ

protected class Or where
  realize_or {𝓜 : M} {φ ψ : F} : 𝓜 ⊧ φ ⋎ ψ ↔ 𝓜 ⊧ φ ∨ 𝓜 ⊧ ψ

protected class Imp where
  realize_imp {𝓜 : M} {φ ψ : F} : 𝓜 ⊧ φ ➝ ψ ↔ (𝓜 ⊧ φ → 𝓜 ⊧ ψ)

protected class Not where
  realize_not {𝓜 : M} {φ : F} : 𝓜 ⊧ ∼φ ↔ ¬𝓜 ⊧ φ

class Tarski extends
  Semantics.Top M,
  Semantics.Bot M,
  Semantics.And M,
  Semantics.Or M,
  Semantics.Imp M,
  Semantics.Not M
  where


attribute [simp]
  Top.realize_top
  Bot.realize_bot
  Not.realize_not
  And.realize_and
  Or.realize_or
  Imp.realize_imp

variable {M}

variable [Tarski M]

variable {𝓜 : M}

    𝓜 ⊧ φ ⭤ ψ ↔ ((𝓜 ⊧ φ) ↔ (𝓜 ⊧ ψ)) := by
  simp [LogicalConnective.iff, iff_iff_implies_and_implies]

@[simp] lemma realize_list_conj {l : List F} :
    𝓜 ⊧ l.conj ↔ ∀ φ ∈ l, 𝓜 ⊧ φ := by induction l <;> simp [*]

@[simp] lemma realize_finset_conj {s : Finset F} :
    𝓜 ⊧ s.conj ↔ ∀ φ ∈ s, 𝓜 ⊧ φ := by simp [Finset.conj]

@[simp] lemma realize_list_disj {l : List F} :
    𝓜 ⊧ l.disj ↔ ∃ φ ∈ l, 𝓜 ⊧ φ := by induction l <;> simp [*]

@[simp] lemma realize_finset_disj {s : Finset F} :
    𝓜 ⊧ s.disj ↔ ∃ φ ∈ s, 𝓜 ⊧ φ := by simp [Finset.disj]

import Foundation.Logic.LogicSymbol

/-!
# Basic definitions and properties of semantics-related notions

This file defines the semantics of formulas based on Tarski's truth definitions.
Also provides 𝓜 characterization of compactness.

## Main Definitions
* `LO.Semantics`: The realization of 𝓜 formula.
* `LO.Compact`: The semantic compactness of Foundation.

## Notation
* `𝓜 ⊧ φ`: a proposition that states `𝓜` satisfies `φ`.
* `𝓜 ⊧* T`: a proposition that states that `𝓜` satisfies each formulae in a set `T`.

-/

namespace LO

class Semantics (F : outParam Type*) (M : Type*) where
  Realize : M → F → Prop

variable {M : Type*} {F : Type*} [𝓢 : Semantics F M]

namespace Semantics

infix:45 " ⊧ " => Realize

section

variable [LogicalConnective F] (M)

protected class Top where
  realize_top (𝓜 : M) : 𝓜 ⊧ (⊤ : F)

protected class Bot where
  realize_bot (𝓜 : M) : ¬𝓜 ⊧ (⊥ : F)

protected class And where
  realize_and {𝓜 : M} {φ ψ : F} : 𝓜 ⊧ φ ⋏ ψ ↔ 𝓜 ⊧ φ ∧ 𝓜 ⊧ ψ

protected class Or where
  realize_or {𝓜 : M} {φ ψ : F} : 𝓜 ⊧ φ ⋎ ψ ↔ 𝓜 ⊧ φ ∨ 𝓜 ⊧ ψ

protected class Imp where
  realize_imp {𝓜 : M} {φ ψ : F} : 𝓜 ⊧ φ ➝ ψ ↔ (𝓜 ⊧ φ → 𝓜 ⊧ ψ)

protected class Not where
  realize_not {𝓜 : M} {φ : F} : 𝓜 ⊧ ∼φ ↔ ¬𝓜 ⊧ φ

class Tarski extends
  Semantics.Top M,
  Semantics.Bot M,
  Semantics.And M,
  Semantics.Or M,
  Semantics.Imp M,
  Semantics.Not M
  where


attribute [simp]
  Top.realize_top
  Bot.realize_bot
  Not.realize_not
  And.realize_and
  Or.realize_or
  Imp.realize_imp

variable {M}

variable [Tarski M]

variable {𝓜 : M}

@[simp] lemma realize_iff {φ ψ : F} :
    𝓜 ⊧ φ ⭤ ψ ↔ ((𝓜 ⊧ φ) ↔ (𝓜 ⊧ ψ)) := by
  simp [LogicalConnective.iff, iff_iff_implies_and_implies]

@[simp] lemma realize_list_conj {l : List F} :
    𝓜 ⊧ l.conj ↔ ∀ φ ∈ l, 𝓜 ⊧ φ := by induction l <;> simp [*]

@[simp] lemma realize_finset_conj {s : Finset F} :
    𝓜 ⊧ s.conj ↔ ∀ φ ∈ s, 𝓜 ⊧ φ := by simp [Finset.conj]

@[simp] lemma realize_list_disj {l : List F} :
    𝓜 ⊧ l.disj ↔ ∃ φ ∈ l, 𝓜 ⊧ φ := by induction l <;> simp [*]

@[simp] lemma realize_finset_disj {s : Finset F} :
    𝓜 ⊧ s.disj ↔ ∃ φ ∈ s, 𝓜 ⊧ φ := by simp [Finset.disj]

end

class RealizeSet (𝓜 : M) (T : Set F) : Prop where
  RealizeSet : ∀ ⦃f⦄, f ∈ T → Realize 𝓜 f

infix:45 " ⊧* " => RealizeSet

variable (M)

def Valid (f : F) : Prop := ∀ 𝓜 : M, 𝓜 ⊧ f

def Satisfiable (T : Set F) : Prop := ∃ 𝓜 : M, 𝓜 ⊧* T

def models (T : Set F) : Set M := {𝓜 | 𝓜 ⊧* T}

variable {M}

def theory (𝓜 : M) : Set F := {φ | 𝓜 ⊧ φ}

class Meaningful (𝓜 : M) : Prop where
  exists_unrealize : ∃ f, ¬𝓜 ⊧ f

content_full:
import Foundation.Logic.LogicSymbol

/-!
# Basic definitions and properties of semantics-related notions

This file defines the semantics of formulas based on Tarski's truth definitions.
Also provides 𝓜 characterization of compactness.

## Main Definitions
* `LO.Semantics`: The realization of 𝓜 formula.
* `LO.Compact`: The semantic compactness of Foundation.

## Notation
* `𝓜 ⊧ φ`: a proposition that states `𝓜` satisfies `φ`.
* `𝓜 ⊧* T`: a proposition that states that `𝓜` satisfies each formulae in a set `T`.

-/

namespace LO

class Semantics (F : outParam Type*) (M : Type*) where
  Realize : M → F → Prop

variable {M : Type*} {F : Type*} [𝓢 : Semantics F M]

namespace Semantics

infix:45 " ⊧ " => Realize

section

variable [LogicalConnective F] (M)

protected class Top where
  realize_top (𝓜 : M) : 𝓜 ⊧ (⊤ : F)

protected class Bot where

import Foundation.Logic.LogicSymbol

/-!
# Basic definitions and properties of semantics-related notions

This file defines the semantics of formulas based on Tarski's truth definitions.
Also provides 𝓜 characterization of compactness.

## Main Definitions
* `LO.Semantics`: The realization of 𝓜 formula.
* `LO.Compact`: The semantic compactness of Foundation.

## Notation
* `𝓜 ⊧ φ`: a proposition that states `𝓜` satisfies `φ`.
* `𝓜 ⊧* T`: a proposition that states that `𝓜` satisfies each formulae in a set `T`.

-/

namespace LO

class Semantics (F : outParam Type*) (M : Type*) where
  Realize : M → F → Prop

variable {M : Type*} {F : Type*} [𝓢 : Semantics F M]

namespace Semantics

infix:45 " ⊧ " => Realize

section

variable [LogicalConnective F] (M)

protected class Top where
  realize_top (𝓜 : M) : 𝓜 ⊧ (⊤ : F)

protected class Bot where
  realize_bot (𝓜 : M) : ¬𝓜 ⊧ (⊥ : F)

protected class And where
  realize_and {𝓜 : M} {φ ψ : F} : 𝓜 ⊧ φ ⋏ ψ ↔ 𝓜 ⊧ φ ∧ 𝓜 ⊧ ψ

protected class Or where
  realize_or {𝓜 : M} {φ ψ : F} : 𝓜 ⊧ φ ⋎ ψ ↔ 𝓜 ⊧ φ ∨ 𝓜 ⊧ ψ

protected class Imp where
  realize_imp {𝓜 : M} {φ ψ : F} : 𝓜 ⊧ φ ➝ ψ ↔ (𝓜 ⊧ φ → 𝓜 ⊧ ψ)

protected class Not where
  realize_not {𝓜 : M} {φ : F} : 𝓜 ⊧ ∼φ ↔ ¬𝓜 ⊧ φ

class Tarski extends
  Semantics.Top M,
  Semantics.Bot M,
  Semantics.And M,
  Semantics.Or M,
  Semantics.Imp M,
  Semantics.Not M
  where


attribute [simp]
  Top.realize_top
  Bot.realize_bot
  Not.realize_not
  And.realize_and
  Or.realize_or
  Imp.realize_imp

variable {M}

variable [Tarski M]

variable {𝓜 : M}

@[simp] lemma realize_iff {φ ψ : F} :
    𝓜 ⊧ φ ⭤ ψ ↔ ((𝓜 ⊧ φ) ↔ (𝓜 ⊧ ψ)) := by
  simp [LogicalConnective.iff, iff_iff_implies_and_implies]

@[simp] lemma realize_list_conj {l : List F} :
    𝓜 ⊧ l.conj ↔ ∀ φ ∈ l, 𝓜 ⊧ φ := by induction l <;> simp [*]

@[simp] lemma realize_finset_conj {s : Finset F} :
    𝓜 ⊧ s.conj ↔ ∀ φ ∈ s, 𝓜 ⊧ φ := by simp [Finset.conj]

@[simp] lemma realize_list_disj {l : List F} :
    𝓜 ⊧ l.disj ↔ ∃ φ ∈ l, 𝓜 ⊧ φ := by induction l <;> simp [*]

@[simp] lemma realize_finset_disj {s : Finset F} :
    𝓜 ⊧ s.disj ↔ ∃ φ ∈ s, 𝓜 ⊧ φ := by simp [Finset.disj]

end

def models (T : Set F) : Set M := {𝓜 | 𝓜 ⊧* T}

import Foundation.Logic.LogicSymbol

/-!
# Basic definitions and properties of semantics-related notions

This file defines the semantics of formulas based on Tarski's truth definitions.
Also provides 𝓜 characterization of compactness.

## Main Definitions
* `LO.Semantics`: The realization of 𝓜 formula.
* `LO.Compact`: The semantic compactness of Foundation.

## Notation
* `𝓜 ⊧ φ`: a proposition that states `𝓜` satisfies `φ`.
* `𝓜 ⊧* T`: a proposition that states that `𝓜` satisfies each formulae in a set `T`.

-/

namespace LO

class Semantics (F : outParam Type*) (M : Type*) where
  Realize : M → F → Prop

variable {M : Type*} {F : Type*} [𝓢 : Semantics F M]

namespace Semantics

infix:45 " ⊧ " => Realize

section

variable [LogicalConnective F] (M)

protected class Top where
  realize_top (𝓜 : M) : 𝓜 ⊧ (⊤ : F)

protected class Bot where
  realize_bot (𝓜 : M) : ¬𝓜 ⊧ (⊥ : F)

protected class And where
  realize_and {𝓜 : M} {φ ψ : F} : 𝓜 ⊧ φ ⋏ ψ ↔ 𝓜 ⊧ φ ∧ 𝓜 ⊧ ψ

protected class Or where
  realize_or {𝓜 : M} {φ ψ : F} : 𝓜 ⊧ φ ⋎ ψ ↔ 𝓜 ⊧ φ ∨ 𝓜 ⊧ ψ

protected class Imp where
  realize_imp {𝓜 : M} {φ ψ : F} : 𝓜 ⊧ φ ➝ ψ ↔ (𝓜 ⊧ φ → 𝓜 ⊧ ψ)

protected class Not where
  realize_not {𝓜 : M} {φ : F} : 𝓜 ⊧ ∼φ ↔ ¬𝓜 ⊧ φ

class Tarski extends
  Semantics.Top M,
  Semantics.Bot M,
  Semantics.And M,
  Semantics.Or M,
  Semantics.Imp M,
  Semantics.Not M
  where


attribute [simp]
  Top.realize_top
  Bot.realize_bot
  Not.realize_not
  And.realize_and
  Or.realize_or
  Imp.realize_imp

variable {M}

variable [Tarski M]

variable {𝓜 : M}

@[simp] lemma realize_iff {φ ψ : F} :
    𝓜 ⊧ φ ⭤ ψ ↔ ((𝓜 ⊧ φ) ↔ (𝓜 ⊧ ψ)) := by
  simp [LogicalConnective.iff, iff_iff_implies_and_implies]

@[simp] lemma realize_list_conj {l : List F} :
    𝓜 ⊧ l.conj ↔ ∀ φ ∈ l, 𝓜 ⊧ φ := by induction l <;> simp [*]

@[simp] lemma realize_finset_conj {s : Finset F} :
    𝓜 ⊧ s.conj ↔ ∀ φ ∈ s, 𝓜 ⊧ φ := by simp [Finset.conj]

@[simp] lemma realize_list_disj {l : List F} :
    𝓜 ⊧ l.disj ↔ ∃ φ ∈ l, 𝓜 ⊧ φ := by induction l <;> simp [*]

@[simp] lemma realize_finset_disj {s : Finset F} :
    𝓜 ⊧ s.disj ↔ ∃ φ ∈ s, 𝓜 ⊧ φ := by simp [Finset.disj]

end

class RealizeSet (𝓜 : M) (T : Set F) : Prop where
  RealizeSet : ∀ ⦃f⦄, f ∈ T → Realize 𝓜 f

infix:45 " ⊧* " => RealizeSet

variable (M)

def Valid (f : F) : Prop := ∀ 𝓜 : M, 𝓜 ⊧ f

def Satisfiable (T : Set F) : Prop := ∃ 𝓜 : M, 𝓜 ⊧* T

def models (T : Set F) : Set M := {𝓜 | 𝓜 ⊧* T}

variable {M}

def theory (𝓜 : M) : Set F := {φ | 𝓜 ⊧ φ}

class Meaningful (𝓜 : M) : Prop where
  exists_unrealize : ∃ f, ¬𝓜 ⊧ f

import Foundation.Logic.LogicSymbol

/-!
# Basic definitions and properties of semantics-related notions

This file defines the semantics of formulas based on Tarski's truth definitions.
Also provides 𝓜 characterization of compactness.

## Main Definitions
* `LO.Semantics`: The realization of 𝓜 formula.
* `LO.Compact`: The semantic compactness of Foundation.

## Notation
* `𝓜 ⊧ φ`: a proposition that states `𝓜` satisfies `φ`.
* `𝓜 ⊧* T`: a proposition that states that `𝓜` satisfies each formulae in a set `T`.

-/

namespace LO

class Semantics (F : outParam Type*) (M : Type*) where
  Realize : M → F → Prop

variable {M : Type*} {F : Type*} [𝓢 : Semantics F M]

namespace Semantics

infix:45 " ⊧ " => Realize

section

variable [LogicalConnective F] (M)

protected class Top where
  realize_top (𝓜 : M) : 𝓜 ⊧ (⊤ : F)

protected class Bot where
  realize_bot (𝓜 : M) : ¬𝓜 ⊧ (⊥ : F)

protected class And where
  realize_and {𝓜 : M} {φ ψ : F} : 𝓜 ⊧ φ ⋏ ψ ↔ 𝓜 ⊧ φ ∧ 𝓜 ⊧ ψ

protected class Or where
  realize_or {𝓜 : M} {φ ψ : F} : 𝓜 ⊧ φ ⋎ ψ ↔ 𝓜 ⊧ φ ∨ 𝓜 ⊧ ψ

protected class Imp where
  realize_imp {𝓜 : M} {φ ψ : F} : 𝓜 ⊧ φ ➝ ψ ↔ (𝓜 ⊧ φ → 𝓜 ⊧ ψ)

protected class Not where
  realize_not {𝓜 : M} {φ : F} : 𝓜 ⊧ ∼φ ↔ ¬𝓜 ⊧ φ

class Tarski extends
  Semantics.Top M,
  Semantics.Bot M,
  Semantics.And M,
  Semantics.Or M,
  Semantics.Imp M,
  Semantics.Not M
  where


attribute [simp]
  Top.realize_top
  Bot.realize_bot
  Not.realize_not
  And.realize_and
  Or.realize_or
  Imp.realize_imp

variable {M}

variable [Tarski M]

variable {𝓜 : M}

@[simp] lemma realize_iff {φ ψ : F} :
    𝓜 ⊧ φ ⭤ ψ ↔ ((𝓜 ⊧ φ) ↔ (𝓜 ⊧ ψ)) := by
  simp [LogicalConnective.iff, iff_iff_implies_and_implies]

@[simp] lemma realize_list_conj {l : List F} :
    𝓜 ⊧ l.conj ↔ ∀ φ ∈ l, 𝓜 ⊧ φ := by induction l <;> simp [*]

@[simp] lemma realize_finset_conj {s : Finset F} :
    𝓜 ⊧ s.conj ↔ ∀ φ ∈ s, 𝓜 ⊧ φ := by simp [Finset.conj]

@[simp] lemma realize_list_disj {l : List F} :
    𝓜 ⊧ l.disj ↔ ∃ φ ∈ l, 𝓜 ⊧ φ := by induction l <;> simp [*]

@[simp] lemma realize_finset_disj {s : Finset F} :
    𝓜 ⊧ s.disj ↔ ∃ φ ∈ s, 𝓜 ⊧ φ := by simp [Finset.disj]

end

class RealizeSet (𝓜 : M) (T : Set F) : Prop where
  RealizeSet : ∀ ⦃f⦄, f ∈ T → Realize 𝓜 f

infix:45 " ⊧* " => RealizeSet

variable (M)

def Valid (f : F) : Prop := ∀ 𝓜 : M, 𝓜 ⊧ f

def Satisfiable (T : Set F) : Prop := ∃ 𝓜 : M, 𝓜 ⊧* T

def models (T : Set F) : Set M := {𝓜 | 𝓜 ⊧* T}

variable {M}

def theory (𝓜 : M) : Set F := {φ | 𝓜 ⊧ φ}

class Meaningful (𝓜 : M) : Prop where
  exists_unrealize : ∃ f, ¬𝓜 ⊧ f

import Foundation.Logic.LogicSymbol

/-!
# Basic definitions and properties of semantics-related notions

This file defines the semantics of formulas based on Tarski's truth definitions.
Also provides 𝓜 characterization of compactness.

## Main Definitions
* `LO.Semantics`: The realization of 𝓜 formula.
* `LO.Compact`: The semantic compactness of Foundation.

## Notation
* `𝓜 ⊧ φ`: a proposition that states `𝓜` satisfies `φ`.
* `𝓜 ⊧* T`: a proposition that states that `𝓜` satisfies each formulae in a set `T`.

-/

namespace LO

class Semantics (F : outParam Type*) (M : Type*) where
  Realize : M → F → Prop

variable {M : Type*} {F : Type*} [𝓢 : Semantics F M]

namespace Semantics

infix:45 " ⊧ " => Realize

section

variable [LogicalConnective F] (M)

protected class Top where
  realize_top (𝓜 : M) : 𝓜 ⊧ (⊤ : F)

protected class Bot where
  realize_bot (𝓜 : M) : ¬𝓜 ⊧ (⊥ : F)

protected class And where
  realize_and {𝓜 : M} {φ ψ : F} : 𝓜 ⊧ φ ⋏ ψ ↔ 𝓜 ⊧ φ ∧ 𝓜 ⊧ ψ

protected class Or where
  realize_or {𝓜 : M} {φ ψ : F} : 𝓜 ⊧ φ ⋎ ψ ↔ 𝓜 ⊧ φ ∨ 𝓜 ⊧ ψ

protected class Imp where
  realize_imp {𝓜 : M} {φ ψ : F} : 𝓜 ⊧ φ ➝ ψ ↔ (𝓜 ⊧ φ → 𝓜 ⊧ ψ)

protected class Not where
  realize_not {𝓜 : M} {φ : F} : 𝓜 ⊧ ∼φ ↔ ¬𝓜 ⊧ φ

class Tarski extends
  Semantics.Top M,
  Semantics.Bot M,
  Semantics.And M,
  Semantics.Or M,
  Semantics.Imp M,
  Semantics.Not M
  where


attribute [simp]
  Top.realize_top
  Bot.realize_bot
  Not.realize_not
  And.realize_and
  Or.realize_or
  Imp.realize_imp

variable {M}

variable [Tarski M]

variable {𝓜 : M}

@[simp] lemma realize_iff {φ ψ : F} :
    𝓜 ⊧ φ ⭤ ψ ↔ ((𝓜 ⊧ φ) ↔ (𝓜 ⊧ ψ)) := by
  simp [LogicalConnective.iff, iff_iff_implies_and_implies]

@[simp] lemma realize_list_conj {l : List F} :
    𝓜 ⊧ l.conj ↔ ∀ φ ∈ l, 𝓜 ⊧ φ := by induction l <;> simp [*]

@[simp] lemma realize_finset_conj {s : Finset F} :
    𝓜 ⊧ s.conj ↔ ∀ φ ∈ s, 𝓜 ⊧ φ := by simp [Finset.conj]

@[simp] lemma realize_list_disj {l : List F} :
    𝓜 ⊧ l.disj ↔ ∃ φ ∈ l, 𝓜 ⊧ φ := by induction l <;> simp [*]

@[simp] lemma realize_finset_disj {s : Finset F} :
    𝓜 ⊧ s.disj ↔ ∃ φ ∈ s, 𝓜 ⊧ φ := by simp [Finset.disj]

end

class RealizeSet (𝓜 : M) (T : Set F) : Prop where
  RealizeSet : ∀ ⦃f⦄, f ∈ T → Realize 𝓜 f

infix:45 " ⊧* " => RealizeSet

variable (M)

def Valid (f : F) : Prop := ∀ 𝓜 : M, 𝓜 ⊧ f

def Satisfiable (T : Set F) : Prop := ∃ 𝓜 : M, 𝓜 ⊧* T

def models (T : Set F) : Set M := {𝓜 | 𝓜 ⊧* T}

variable {M}

def theory (𝓜 : M) : Set F := {φ | 𝓜 ⊧ φ}

class Meaningful (𝓜 : M) : Prop where
  exists_unrealize : ∃ f, ¬𝓜 ⊧ f

import Foundation.Logic.LogicSymbol

/-!
# Basic definitions and properties of semantics-related notions

This file defines the semantics of formulas based on Tarski's truth definitions.
Also provides 𝓜 characterization of compactness.

## Main Definitions
* `LO.Semantics`: The realization of 𝓜 formula.
* `LO.Compact`: The semantic compactness of Foundation.

## Notation
* `𝓜 ⊧ φ`: a proposition that states `𝓜` satisfies `φ`.
* `𝓜 ⊧* T`: a proposition that states that `𝓜` satisfies each formulae in a set `T`.

-/

namespace LO

class Semantics (F : outParam Type*) (M : Type*) where
  Realize : M → F → Prop

variable {M : Type*} {F : Type*} [𝓢 : Semantics F M]

namespace Semantics

infix:45 " ⊧ " => Realize

section

variable [LogicalConnective F] (M)

protected class Top where
  realize_top (𝓜 : M) : 𝓜 ⊧ (⊤ : F)

protected class Bot where
  realize_bot (𝓜 : M) : ¬𝓜 ⊧ (⊥ : F)

protected class And where
  realize_and {𝓜 : M} {φ ψ : F} : 𝓜 ⊧ φ ⋏ ψ ↔ 𝓜 ⊧ φ ∧ 𝓜 ⊧ ψ

protected class Or where
  realize_or {𝓜 : M} {φ ψ : F} : 𝓜 ⊧ φ ⋎ ψ ↔ 𝓜 ⊧ φ ∨ 𝓜 ⊧ ψ

protected class Imp where
  realize_imp {𝓜 : M} {φ ψ : F} : 𝓜 ⊧ φ ➝ ψ ↔ (𝓜 ⊧ φ → 𝓜 ⊧ ψ)

protected class Not where
  realize_not {𝓜 : M} {φ : F} : 𝓜 ⊧ ∼φ ↔ ¬𝓜 ⊧ φ

class Tarski extends
  Semantics.Top M,
  Semantics.Bot M,
  Semantics.And M,
  Semantics.Or M,
  Semantics.Imp M,
  Semantics.Not M
  where


attribute [simp]
  Top.realize_top
  Bot.realize_bot
  Not.realize_not
  And.realize_and
  Or.realize_or
  Imp.realize_imp

variable {M}

variable [Tarski M]

variable {𝓜 : M}

@[simp] lemma realize_iff {φ ψ : F} :
    𝓜 ⊧ φ ⭤ ψ ↔ ((𝓜 ⊧ φ) ↔ (𝓜 ⊧ ψ)) := by
  simp [LogicalConnective.iff, iff_iff_implies_and_implies]

@[simp] lemma realize_list_conj {l : List F} :
    𝓜 ⊧ l.conj ↔ ∀ φ ∈ l, 𝓜 ⊧ φ := by induction l <;> simp [*]

@[simp] lemma realize_finset_conj {s : Finset F} :
    𝓜 ⊧ s.conj ↔ ∀ φ ∈ s, 𝓜 ⊧ φ := by simp [Finset.conj]

@[simp] lemma realize_list_disj {l : List F} :
    𝓜 ⊧ l.disj ↔ ∃ φ ∈ l, 𝓜 ⊧ φ := by induction l <;> simp [*]

This file defines the semantics of formulas based on Tarski's truth definitions.
Also provides 𝓜 characterization of compactness.

## Main Definitions
* `LO.Semantics`: The realization of 𝓜 formula.
* `LO.Compact`: The semantic compactness of Foundation.

## Notation
* `𝓜 ⊧ φ`: a proposition that states `𝓜` satisfies `φ`.
* `𝓜 ⊧* T`: a proposition that states that `𝓜` satisfies each formulae in a set `T`.

-/

namespace LO

class Semantics (F : outParam Type*) (M : Type*) where
  Realize : M → F → Prop

variable {M : Type*} {F : Type*} [𝓢 : Semantics F M]

namespace Semantics

infix:45 " ⊧ " => Realize

section

variable [LogicalConnective F] (M)

protected class Top where
  realize_top (𝓜 : M) : 𝓜 ⊧ (⊤ : F)

protected class Bot where
  realize_bot (𝓜 : M) : ¬𝓜 ⊧ (⊥ : F)

protected class And where
  realize_and {𝓜 : M} {φ ψ : F} : 𝓜 ⊧ φ ⋏ ψ ↔ 𝓜 ⊧ φ ∧ 𝓜 ⊧ ψ

protected class Or where
  realize_or {𝓜 : M} {φ ψ : F} : 𝓜 ⊧ φ ⋎ ψ ↔ 𝓜 ⊧ φ ∨ 𝓜 ⊧ ψ

protected class Imp where
  realize_imp {𝓜 : M} {φ ψ : F} : 𝓜 ⊧ φ ➝ ψ ↔ (𝓜 ⊧ φ → 𝓜 ⊧ ψ)

protected class Not where
  realize_not {𝓜 : M} {φ : F} : 𝓜 ⊧ ∼φ ↔ ¬𝓜 ⊧ φ

class Tarski extends
  Semantics.Top M,
  Semantics.Bot M,
  Semantics.And M,
  Semantics.Or M,
  Semantics.Imp M,
  Semantics.Not M
  where


attribute [simp]
  Top.realize_top
  Bot.realize_bot
  Not.realize_not
  And.realize_and
  Or.realize_or
  Imp.realize_imp

variable {M}

variable [Tarski M]

variable {𝓜 : M}

@[simp] lemma realize_iff {φ ψ : F} :
    𝓜 ⊧ φ ⭤ ψ ↔ ((𝓜 ⊧ φ) ↔ (𝓜 ⊧ ψ)) := by
  simp [LogicalConnective.iff, iff_iff_implies_and_implies]

@[simp] lemma realize_list_conj {l : List F} :
    𝓜 ⊧ l.conj ↔ ∀ φ ∈ l, 𝓜 ⊧ φ := by induction l <;> simp [*]

@[simp] lemma realize_finset_conj {s : Finset F} :
    𝓜 ⊧ s.conj ↔ ∀ φ ∈ s, 𝓜 ⊧ φ := by simp [Finset.conj]

@[simp] lemma realize_list_disj {l : List F} :
    𝓜 ⊧ l.disj ↔ ∃ φ ∈ l, 𝓜 ⊧ φ := by induction l <;> simp [*]

@[simp] lemma realize_finset_disj {s : Finset F} :
    𝓜 ⊧ s.disj ↔ ∃ φ ∈ s, 𝓜 ⊧ φ := by simp [Finset.disj]

end

class RealizeSet (𝓜 : M) (T : Set F) : Prop where
  RealizeSet : ∀ ⦃f⦄, f ∈ T → Realize 𝓜 f

infix:45 " ⊧* " => RealizeSet

variable (M)

def Valid (f : F) : Prop := ∀ 𝓜 : M, 𝓜 ⊧ f

def Satisfiable (T : Set F) : Prop := ∃ 𝓜 : M, 𝓜 ⊧* T

def models (T : Set F) : Set M := {𝓜 | 𝓜 ⊧* T}

variable {M}

def theory (𝓜 : M) : Set F := {φ | 𝓜 ⊧ φ}
annotation: def theory (𝓜 : M) : Set F := {φ | 𝓜 ⊧ φ}

and predicates.

import Foundation.Logic.LogicSymbol

/-!
# Basic definitions and properties of semantics-related notions

This file defines the semantics of formulas based on Tarski's truth definitions.
Also provides 𝓜 characterization of compactness.

## Main Definitions
* `LO.Semantics`: The realization of 𝓜 formula.
* `LO.Compact`: The semantic compactness of Foundation.

## Notation
* `𝓜 ⊧ φ`: a proposition that states `𝓜` satisfies `φ`.
* `𝓜 ⊧* T`: a proposition that states that `𝓜` satisfies each formulae in a set `T`.

-/

namespace LO

class Semantics (F : outParam Type*) (M : Type*) where
  Realize : M → F → Prop

variable {M : Type*} {F : Type*} [𝓢 : Semantics F M]

namespace Semantics

infix:45 " ⊧ " => Realize

section

variable [LogicalConnective F] (M)

protected class Top where
  realize_top (𝓜 : M) : 𝓜 ⊧ (⊤ : F)

protected class Bot where
  realize_bot (𝓜 : M) : ¬𝓜 ⊧ (⊥ : F)

protected class And where
  realize_and {𝓜 : M} {φ ψ : F} : 𝓜 ⊧ φ ⋏ ψ ↔ 𝓜 ⊧ φ ∧ 𝓜 ⊧ ψ

protected class Or where
  realize_or {𝓜 : M} {φ ψ : F} : 𝓜 ⊧ φ ⋎ ψ ↔ 𝓜 ⊧ φ ∨ 𝓜 ⊧ ψ

protected class Imp where
  realize_imp {𝓜 : M} {φ ψ : F} : 𝓜 ⊧ φ ➝ ψ ↔ (𝓜 ⊧ φ → 𝓜 ⊧ ψ)

protected class Not where
  realize_not {𝓜 : M} {φ : F} : 𝓜 ⊧ ∼φ ↔ ¬𝓜 ⊧ φ

class Tarski extends
  Semantics.Top M,
  Semantics.Bot M,
  Semantics.And M,
  Semantics.Or M,
  Semantics.Imp M,
  Semantics.Not M
  where


attribute [simp]
  Top.realize_top
  Bot.realize_bot
  Not.realize_not
  And.realize_and
  Or.realize_or
  Imp.realize_imp

variable {M}

variable [Tarski M]

variable {𝓜 : M}

@[simp] lemma realize_iff {φ ψ : F} :
    𝓜 ⊧ φ ⭤ ψ ↔ ((𝓜 ⊧ φ) ↔ (𝓜 ⊧ ψ)) := by
  simp [LogicalConnective.iff, iff_iff_implies_and_implies]

@[simp] lemma realize_list_conj {l : List F} :
    𝓜 ⊧ l.conj ↔ ∀ φ ∈ l, 𝓜 ⊧ φ := by induction l <;> simp [*]

@[simp] lemma realize_finset_conj {s : Finset F} :
    𝓜 ⊧ s.conj ↔ ∀ φ ∈ s, 𝓜 ⊧ φ := by simp [Finset.conj]

@[simp] lemma realize_list_disj {l : List F} :
    𝓜 ⊧ l.disj ↔ ∃ φ ∈ l, 𝓜 ⊧ φ := by induction l <;> simp [*]

@[simp] lemma realize_finset_disj {s : Finset F} :
    𝓜 ⊧ s.disj ↔ ∃ φ ∈ s, 𝓜 ⊧ φ := by simp [Finset.disj]

end

class RealizeSet (𝓜 : M) (T : Set F) : Prop where
  RealizeSet : ∀ ⦃f⦄, f ∈ T → Realize 𝓜 f

/-!
# Basic definitions and properties of semantics-related notions

This file defines the semantics of formulas based on Tarski's truth definitions.
Also provides 𝓜 characterization of compactness.

## Main Definitions
* `LO.Semantics`: The realization of 𝓜 formula.
* `LO.Compact`: The semantic compactness of Foundation.

## Notation
* `𝓜 ⊧ φ`: a proposition that states `𝓜` satisfies `φ`.
* `𝓜 ⊧* T`: a proposition that states that `𝓜` satisfies each formulae in a set `T`.

-/

namespace LO

class Semantics (F : outParam Type*) (M : Type*) where
  Realize : M → F → Prop

variable {M : Type*} {F : Type*} [𝓢 : Semantics F M]

namespace Semantics

infix:45 " ⊧ " => Realize

section

variable [LogicalConnective F] (M)

protected class Top where
  realize_top (𝓜 : M) : 𝓜 ⊧ (⊤ : F)

protected class Bot where
  realize_bot (𝓜 : M) : ¬𝓜 ⊧ (⊥ : F)

protected class And where
  realize_and {𝓜 : M} {φ ψ : F} : 𝓜 ⊧ φ ⋏ ψ ↔ 𝓜 ⊧ φ ∧ 𝓜 ⊧ ψ

protected class Or where
  realize_or {𝓜 : M} {φ ψ : F} : 𝓜 ⊧ φ ⋎ ψ ↔ 𝓜 ⊧ φ ∨ 𝓜 ⊧ ψ

protected class Imp where
  realize_imp {𝓜 : M} {φ ψ : F} : 𝓜 ⊧ φ ➝ ψ ↔ (𝓜 ⊧ φ → 𝓜 ⊧ ψ)

protected class Not where
  realize_not {𝓜 : M} {φ : F} : 𝓜 ⊧ ∼φ ↔ ¬𝓜 ⊧ φ

class Tarski extends
  Semantics.Top M,
  Semantics.Bot M,
  Semantics.And M,
  Semantics.Or M,
  Semantics.Imp M,
  Semantics.Not M
  where


attribute [simp]
  Top.realize_top
  Bot.realize_bot
  Not.realize_not
  And.realize_and
  Or.realize_or
  Imp.realize_imp

variable {M}

variable [Tarski M]

variable {𝓜 : M}

@[simp] lemma realize_iff {φ ψ : F} :
    𝓜 ⊧ φ ⭤ ψ ↔ ((𝓜 ⊧ φ) ↔ (𝓜 ⊧ ψ)) := by
  simp [LogicalConnective.iff, iff_iff_implies_and_implies]

    𝓜 ⊧ l.disj ↔ ∃ φ ∈ l, 𝓜 ⊧ φ := by induction l <;> simp [*]

@[simp] lemma realize_finset_disj {s : Finset F} :

## Notation
* `𝓜 ⊧ φ`: a proposition that states `𝓜` satisfies `φ`.
* `𝓜 ⊧* T`: a proposition that states that `𝓜` satisfies each formulae in a set `T`.

-/

namespace LO

class Semantics (F : outParam Type*) (M : Type*) where
  Realize : M → F → Prop

variable {M : Type*} {F : Type*} [𝓢 : Semantics F M]

namespace Semantics

infix:45 " ⊧ " => Realize

section

variable [LogicalConnective F] (M)

protected class Top where
  realize_top (𝓜 : M) : 𝓜 ⊧ (⊤ : F)

protected class Bot where
  realize_bot (𝓜 : M) : ¬𝓜 ⊧ (⊥ : F)

protected class And where
  realize_and {𝓜 : M} {φ ψ : F} : 𝓜 ⊧ φ ⋏ ψ ↔ 𝓜 ⊧ φ ∧ 𝓜 ⊧ ψ

protected class Or where
  realize_or {𝓜 : M} {φ ψ : F} : 𝓜 ⊧ φ ⋎ ψ ↔ 𝓜 ⊧ φ ∨ 𝓜 ⊧ ψ

protected class Imp where
  realize_imp {𝓜 : M} {φ ψ : F} : 𝓜 ⊧ φ ➝ ψ ↔ (𝓜 ⊧ φ → 𝓜 ⊧ ψ)

protected class Not where
  realize_not {𝓜 : M} {φ : F} : 𝓜 ⊧ ∼φ ↔ ¬𝓜 ⊧ φ

class Tarski extends
  Semantics.Top M,
  Semantics.Bot M,
  Semantics.And M,
  Semantics.Or M,
  Semantics.Imp M,
  Semantics.Not M
  where


attribute [simp]
  Top.realize_top
  Bot.realize_bot
  Not.realize_not
  And.realize_and
  Or.realize_or
  Imp.realize_imp

variable {M}

variable [Tarski M]

variable {𝓜 : M}

@[simp] lemma realize_iff {φ ψ : F} :
    𝓜 ⊧ φ ⭤ ψ ↔ ((𝓜 ⊧ φ) ↔ (𝓜 ⊧ ψ)) := by
  simp [LogicalConnective.iff, iff_iff_implies_and_implies]

@[simp] lemma realize_list_conj {l : List F} :
    𝓜 ⊧ l.conj ↔ ∀ φ ∈ l, 𝓜 ⊧ φ := by induction l <;> simp [*]

@[simp] lemma realize_finset_conj {s : Finset F} :
    𝓜 ⊧ s.conj ↔ ∀ φ ∈ s, 𝓜 ⊧ φ := by simp [Finset.conj]

@[simp] lemma realize_list_disj {l : List F} :
    𝓜 ⊧ l.disj ↔ ∃ φ ∈ l, 𝓜 ⊧ φ := by induction l <;> simp [*]

@[simp] lemma realize_finset_disj {s : Finset F} :
    𝓜 ⊧ s.disj ↔ ∃ φ ∈ s, 𝓜 ⊧ φ := by simp [Finset.disj]

end

class RealizeSet (𝓜 : M) (T : Set F) : Prop where
  RealizeSet : ∀ ⦃f⦄, f ∈ T → Realize 𝓜 f

infix:45 " ⊧* " => RealizeSet

variable (M)

def Valid (f : F) : Prop := ∀ 𝓜 : M, 𝓜 ⊧ f

def Satisfiable (T : Set F) : Prop := ∃ 𝓜 : M, 𝓜 ⊧* T
annotation: def Satisfiable (T : Set F) : Prop := ∃ 𝓜 : M, 𝓜 ⊧* T

and predicates.

Also provides 𝓜 characterization of compactness.

* `LO.Semantics`: The realization of 𝓜 formula.
* `LO.Compact`: The semantic compactness of Foundation.

## Notation
* `𝓜 ⊧ φ`: a proposition that states `𝓜` satisfies `φ`.
* `𝓜 ⊧* T`: a proposition that states that `𝓜` satisfies each formulae in a set `T`.

-/

  realize_imp {𝓜 : M} {φ ψ : F} : 𝓜 ⊧ φ ➝ ψ ↔ (𝓜 ⊧ φ → 𝓜 ⊧ ψ)

protected class Not where
  realize_not {𝓜 : M} {φ : F} : 𝓜 ⊧ ∼φ ↔ ¬𝓜 ⊧ φ

content_full:
import Foundation.Logic.LogicSymbol

/-!
# Basic definitions and properties of semantics-related notions

This file defines the semantics of formulas based on Tarski's truth definitions.
Also provides 𝓜 characterization of compactness.

## Main Definitions
* `LO.Semantics`: The realization of 𝓜 formula.
* `LO.Compact`: The semantic compactness of Foundation.

## Notation
* `𝓜 ⊧ φ`: a proposition that states `𝓜` satisfies `φ`.
* `𝓜 ⊧* T`: a proposition that states that `𝓜` satisfies each formulae in a set `T`.

-/

namespace LO

class Semantics (F : outParam Type*) (M : Type*) where
  Realize : M → F → Prop

variable {M : Type*} {F : Type*} [𝓢 : Semantics F M]

namespace Semantics

infix:45 " ⊧ " => Realize

section

variable [LogicalConnective F] (M)

protected class Top where
  realize_top (𝓜 : M) : 𝓜 ⊧ (⊤ : F)

protected class Bot where
  realize_bot (𝓜 : M) : ¬𝓜 ⊧ (⊥ : F)

protected class And where
  realize_and {𝓜 : M} {φ ψ : F} : 𝓜 ⊧ φ ⋏ ψ ↔ 𝓜 ⊧ φ ∧ 𝓜 ⊧ ψ

protected class Or where
  realize_or {𝓜 : M} {φ ψ : F} : 𝓜 ⊧ φ ⋎ ψ ↔ 𝓜 ⊧ φ ∨ 𝓜 ⊧ ψ

protected class Imp where
  realize_imp {𝓜 : M} {φ ψ : F} : 𝓜 ⊧ φ ➝ ψ ↔ (𝓜 ⊧ φ → 𝓜 ⊧ ψ)

protected class Not where
  realize_not {𝓜 : M} {φ : F} : 𝓜 ⊧ ∼φ ↔ ¬𝓜 ⊧ φ

class Tarski extends
  Semantics.Top M,
  Semantics.Bot M,
  Semantics.And M,
  Semantics.Or M,
  Semantics.Imp M,
  Semantics.Not M
  where


attribute [simp]
  Top.realize_top
  Bot.realize_bot
  Not.realize_not
  And.realize_and
  Or.realize_or
  Imp.realize_imp

variable {M}

variable [Tarski M]

variable {𝓜 : M}

@[simp] lemma realize_iff {φ ψ : F} :
    𝓜 ⊧ φ ⭤ ψ ↔ ((𝓜 ⊧ φ) ↔ (𝓜 ⊧ ψ)) := by
  simp [LogicalConnective.iff, iff_iff_implies_and_implies]

@[simp] lemma realize_list_conj {l : List F} :
    𝓜 ⊧ l.conj ↔ ∀ φ ∈ l, 𝓜 ⊧ φ := by induction l <;> simp [*]

@[simp] lemma realize_finset_conj {s : Finset F} :
    𝓜 ⊧ s.conj ↔ ∀ φ ∈ s, 𝓜 ⊧ φ := by simp [Finset.conj]

@[simp] lemma realize_list_disj {l : List F} :
    𝓜 ⊧ l.disj ↔ ∃ φ ∈ l, 𝓜 ⊧ φ := by induction l <;> simp [*]

@[simp] lemma realize_finset_disj {s : Finset F} :
    𝓜 ⊧ s.disj ↔ ∃ φ ∈ s, 𝓜 ⊧ φ := by simp [Finset.disj]

end

class RealizeSet (𝓜 : M) (T : Set F) : Prop where
  RealizeSet : ∀ ⦃f⦄, f ∈ T → Realize 𝓜 f

content_full:
import Foundation.Logic.LogicSymbol

/-!
# Basic definitions and properties of semantics-related notions

This file defines the semantics of formulas based on Tarski's truth definitions.
Also provides 𝓜 characterization of compactness.

## Main Definitions
* `LO.Semantics`: The realization of 𝓜 formula.
* `LO.Compact`: The semantic compactness of Foundation.

## Notation
* `𝓜 ⊧ φ`: a proposition that states `𝓜` satisfies `φ`.
* `𝓜 ⊧* T`: a proposition that states that `𝓜` satisfies each formulae in a set `T`.

-/

namespace LO

class Semantics (F : outParam Type*) (M : Type*) where
  Realize : M → F → Prop

variable {M : Type*} {F : Type*} [𝓢 : Semantics F M]

namespace Semantics

infix:45 " ⊧ " => Realize

section

variable [LogicalConnective F] (M)

protected class Top where
  realize_top (𝓜 : M) : 𝓜 ⊧ (⊤ : F)

protected class Bot where
  realize_bot (𝓜 : M) : ¬𝓜 ⊧ (⊥ : F)

protected class And where
  realize_and {𝓜 : M} {φ ψ : F} : 𝓜 ⊧ φ ⋏ ψ ↔ 𝓜 ⊧ φ ∧ 𝓜 ⊧ ψ

protected class Or where
  realize_or {𝓜 : M} {φ ψ : F} : 𝓜 ⊧ φ ⋎ ψ ↔ 𝓜 ⊧ φ ∨ 𝓜 ⊧ ψ

protected class Imp where
  realize_imp {𝓜 : M} {φ ψ : F} : 𝓜 ⊧ φ ➝ ψ ↔ (𝓜 ⊧ φ → 𝓜 ⊧ ψ)

protected class Not where
  realize_not {𝓜 : M} {φ : F} : 𝓜 ⊧ ∼φ ↔ ¬𝓜 ⊧ φ

class Tarski extends
  Semantics.Top M,
  Semantics.Bot M,
  Semantics.And M,
  Semantics.Or M,
  Semantics.Imp M,
  Semantics.Not M
  where


attribute [simp]
  Top.realize_top
  Bot.realize_bot
  Not.realize_not
  And.realize_and
  Or.realize_or
  Imp.realize_imp

variable {M}

variable [Tarski M]

variable {𝓜 : M}

@[simp] lemma realize_iff {φ ψ : F} :
    𝓜 ⊧ φ ⭤ ψ ↔ ((𝓜 ⊧ φ) ↔ (𝓜 ⊧ ψ)) := by
  simp [LogicalConnective.iff, iff_iff_implies_and_implies]

@[simp] lemma realize_list_conj {l : List F} :
    𝓜 ⊧ l.conj ↔ ∀ φ ∈ l, 𝓜 ⊧ φ := by induction l <;> simp [*]

@[simp] lemma realize_finset_conj {s : Finset F} :
    𝓜 ⊧ s.conj ↔ ∀ φ ∈ s, 𝓜 ⊧ φ := by simp [Finset.conj]

@[simp] lemma realize_list_disj {l : List F} :
    𝓜 ⊧ l.disj ↔ ∃ φ ∈ l, 𝓜 ⊧ φ := by induction l <;> simp [*]

@[simp] lemma realize_finset_disj {s : Finset F} :
    𝓜 ⊧ s.disj ↔ ∃ φ ∈ s, 𝓜 ⊧ φ := by simp [Finset.disj]

end

class RealizeSet (𝓜 : M) (T : Set F) : Prop where
  RealizeSet : ∀ ⦃f⦄, f ∈ T → Realize 𝓜 f

content_full:
import Foundation.Logic.LogicSymbol

/-!
# Basic definitions and properties of semantics-related notions

This file defines the semantics of formulas based on Tarski's truth definitions.
Also provides 𝓜 characterization of compactness.

## Main Definitions
* `LO.Semantics`: The realization of 𝓜 formula.
* `LO.Compact`: The semantic compactness of Foundation.

## Notation
* `𝓜 ⊧ φ`: a proposition that states `𝓜` satisfies `φ`.
* `𝓜 ⊧* T`: a proposition that states that `𝓜` satisfies each formulae in a set `T`.

-/

namespace LO

class Semantics (F : outParam Type*) (M : Type*) where
  Realize : M → F → Prop

variable {M : Type*} {F : Type*} [𝓢 : Semantics F M]

namespace Semantics

infix:45 " ⊧ " => Realize

section

variable [LogicalConnective F] (M)

protected class Top where
  realize_top (𝓜 : M) : 𝓜 ⊧ (⊤ : F)

protected class Bot where
  realize_bot (𝓜 : M) : ¬𝓜 ⊧ (⊥ : F)

protected class And where
  realize_and {𝓜 : M} {φ ψ : F} : 𝓜 ⊧ φ ⋏ ψ ↔ 𝓜 ⊧ φ ∧ 𝓜 ⊧ ψ

protected class Or where
  realize_or {𝓜 : M} {φ ψ : F} : 𝓜 ⊧ φ ⋎ ψ ↔ 𝓜 ⊧ φ ∨ 𝓜 ⊧ ψ

protected class Imp where
  realize_imp {𝓜 : M} {φ ψ : F} : 𝓜 ⊧ φ ➝ ψ ↔ (𝓜 ⊧ φ → 𝓜 ⊧ ψ)

protected class Not where
  realize_not {𝓜 : M} {φ : F} : 𝓜 ⊧ ∼φ ↔ ¬𝓜 ⊧ φ

class Tarski extends
  Semantics.Top M,
  Semantics.Bot M,
  Semantics.And M,
  Semantics.Or M,
  Semantics.Imp M,
  Semantics.Not M
  where


attribute [simp]
  Top.realize_top
  Bot.realize_bot
  Not.realize_not
  And.realize_and
  Or.realize_or
  Imp.realize_imp

variable {M}

variable [Tarski M]

variable {𝓜 : M}

@[simp] lemma realize_iff {φ ψ : F} :
    𝓜 ⊧ φ ⭤ ψ ↔ ((𝓜 ⊧ φ) ↔ (𝓜 ⊧ ψ)) := by
  simp [LogicalConnective.iff, iff_iff_implies_and_implies]

@[simp] lemma realize_list_conj {l : List F} :
    𝓜 ⊧ l.conj ↔ ∀ φ ∈ l, 𝓜 ⊧ φ := by induction l <;> simp [*]

@[simp] lemma realize_finset_conj {s : Finset F} :
    𝓜 ⊧ s.conj ↔ ∀ φ ∈ s, 𝓜 ⊧ φ := by simp [Finset.conj]

@[simp] lemma realize_list_disj {l : List F} :
    𝓜 ⊧ l.disj ↔ ∃ φ ∈ l, 𝓜 ⊧ φ := by induction l <;> simp [*]

@[simp] lemma realize_finset_disj {s : Finset F} :
    𝓜 ⊧ s.disj ↔ ∃ φ ∈ s, 𝓜 ⊧ φ := by simp [Finset.disj]

end

class RealizeSet (𝓜 : M) (T : Set F) : Prop where
  RealizeSet : ∀ ⦃f⦄, f ∈ T → Realize 𝓜 f

import Foundation.Logic.LogicSymbol

/-!
# Basic definitions and properties of semantics-related notions

This file defines the semantics of formulas based on Tarski's truth definitions.
Also provides 𝓜 characterization of compactness.

## Main Definitions
* `LO.Semantics`: The realization of 𝓜 formula.
* `LO.Compact`: The semantic compactness of Foundation.

## Notation
* `𝓜 ⊧ φ`: a proposition that states `𝓜` satisfies `φ`.
* `𝓜 ⊧* T`: a proposition that states that `𝓜` satisfies each formulae in a set `T`.

-/

namespace LO

class Semantics (F : outParam Type*) (M : Type*) where
  Realize : M → F → Prop

variable {M : Type*} {F : Type*} [𝓢 : Semantics F M]

namespace Semantics

infix:45 " ⊧ " => Realize

section

variable [LogicalConnective F] (M)

protected class Top where
  realize_top (𝓜 : M) : 𝓜 ⊧ (⊤ : F)

protected class Bot where
  realize_bot (𝓜 : M) : ¬𝓜 ⊧ (⊥ : F)

protected class And where
  realize_and {𝓜 : M} {φ ψ : F} : 𝓜 ⊧ φ ⋏ ψ ↔ 𝓜 ⊧ φ ∧ 𝓜 ⊧ ψ

protected class Or where
  realize_or {𝓜 : M} {φ ψ : F} : 𝓜 ⊧ φ ⋎ ψ ↔ 𝓜 ⊧ φ ∨ 𝓜 ⊧ ψ

protected class Imp where
  realize_imp {𝓜 : M} {φ ψ : F} : 𝓜 ⊧ φ ➝ ψ ↔ (𝓜 ⊧ φ → 𝓜 ⊧ ψ)

protected class Not where
  realize_not {𝓜 : M} {φ : F} : 𝓜 ⊧ ∼φ ↔ ¬𝓜 ⊧ φ

class Tarski extends
  Semantics.Top M,
  Semantics.Bot M,
  Semantics.And M,
  Semantics.Or M,
  Semantics.Imp M,
  Semantics.Not M
  where


attribute [simp]
  Top.realize_top
  Bot.realize_bot
  Not.realize_not
  And.realize_and
  Or.realize_or
  Imp.realize_imp

variable {M}

variable [Tarski M]

variable {𝓜 : M}

@[simp] lemma realize_iff {φ ψ : F} :
    𝓜 ⊧ φ ⭤ ψ ↔ ((𝓜 ⊧ φ) ↔ (𝓜 ⊧ ψ)) := by
  simp [LogicalConnective.iff, iff_iff_implies_and_implies]

@[simp] lemma realize_list_conj {l : List F} :
    𝓜 ⊧ l.conj ↔ ∀ φ ∈ l, 𝓜 ⊧ φ := by induction l <;> simp [*]

@[simp] lemma realize_finset_conj {s : Finset F} :
    𝓜 ⊧ s.conj ↔ ∀ φ ∈ s, 𝓜 ⊧ φ := by simp [Finset.conj]

@[simp] lemma realize_list_disj {l : List F} :
    𝓜 ⊧ l.disj ↔ ∃ φ ∈ l, 𝓜 ⊧ φ := by induction l <;> simp [*]

@[simp] lemma realize_finset_disj {s : Finset F} :
    𝓜 ⊧ s.disj ↔ ∃ φ ∈ s, 𝓜 ⊧ φ := by simp [Finset.disj]

end

  RealizeSet : ∀ ⦃f⦄, f ∈ T → Realize 𝓜 f
